The John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act is groundbreaking federal legislation that will protect the rights of millions of voters across the country. That's why President Biden called for Congress to act on this bill during his annual State of the Union speech.
With what we've seen over the past few years in Texas, in Florida, in John Lewis' own beloved state of Georgia, and beyond -- we need to do EVERYTHING in our power to make sure this law gets signed into law.
We can't do that alone, we need your grassroots pressure on Congress to make it happen. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to fight back against the vote suppressors in Congress and make this bill a law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082924_4&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082924_4&amount=25]
BCJ: Pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082924_4&amount=25]
Team: The landmark John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement has been stuck in the U.S. House of Representatives since last fall. We need your help to get it moving again.
After ten long years of attacks on voting rights, from the 2013 Supreme Court decision in Shelby County v. Holder to the voter suppression bills that swept over our country since the 2020 election, this legislation is a ray of light beaming out from a dark landscape.
This bill would undo the damage done by the Supreme Court and create a Voting Rights Act for the 21st century. It would restore preclearance in states that are discriminating on the basis of race and create preclearance for certain practices that are frequently discriminatory. It would also bolster Section 2 of the original Voting Rights Act, which allows lawsuits to ensure voters of color have the opportunity for fair representation. I n short, this bill would right a lot of wrongs in our democracy.
Team: We need to fight for this bill no matter who controls Congress. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass this critical legislation >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082924_4&amount=25]

The original Voting Rights Act is one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With the Supreme Court dismantling it piece by piece, we need the John Lewis Voting Rights Act to restore our right to vote.
The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice has called the current assault on voting rights "staggering" . According to their accounting, " At least 19 states passed 33 laws in 2021 making it harder to vote. Many of these laws target voters of color, exacerbating persistent racial disparities in access. Turnout for nonwhite voters is now substantially lower than that for white voters — and has been for at least 25 years. Despite record voter turnout in 2020, only 58 percent of nonwhite voters participated, compared to 71 percent of white voters. "
Congress has the power to solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.
Help hold them accountable, Team: Congress needs to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act immediately. Chip in $25 or whatever you can right now to help make it happen >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082924_4&amount=25]

name: LTC (Ret.) Alexander Vindman
subject: An abuse of power I couldn’t ignore
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em_vindman.0ZVE-D&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240829_PM2_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=7348%2E5257348%2Ers5ICB ]Adam posing for a photo with Eugene and Alexander Vindman

Hi Derek.
It’s Alexander Vindman, reaching out to you with a personal request.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=aug2024_abs_em_vindman.A93AxP&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240829_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=7348%2E5257348%2Ers5ICB ]Can you split a contribution between Adam Schiff’s campaign for Senate
and my twin brother Eugene’s campaign for Congress today? I ask because I
know I can count on you.

Derek, I’d
like to take a moment to refresh your memory:

In 2019, Eugene and I found ourselves in an unprecedented situation.

I overheard a shocking phone call between then-President Donald Trump and
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. I listened to Trump pressure
Zelenskyy to investigate Joe Biden, using U.S. military aid as leverage.

It was an abuse of power I couldn’t ignore.

I turned to my brother Eugene, the ethics attorney at the National
Security Council. Together, we blew the whistle on Trump’s corrupt phone
call and reported it up the chain of command.

Eventually, I testified before a closed session of the House Intelligence
Committee.

The man leading that committee was none other than Rep. Adam Schiff.
Adam's commitment to integrity and his fearless leadership resulted in the
first bipartisan vote in a Senate impeachment trial to convict a U.S.
president.

All three of us — Eugene, Adam, and I — did what we could to bring the
truth to light. But it did not come without consequences.

Trump retaliated, ending Eugene’s military career and mine. And since
then, Trump, the Republican Party, and right-wing media have targeted Adam
Schiff relentlessly, attempting to discredit and remove him from Congress
simply because he upheld the rule of law.

But Trump and the GOP cannot stop the pro-democracy movement Eugene and
Adam are building. We NEED leaders like Eugene and Adam in the House and
Senate fighting to defend our democracy, and they know it.

However, it won’t be easy.

Adam, Eugene, and I have all dealt with Republicans’ attacks and insults.
The MAGA movement wants nothing more than to defeat Adam and Eugene this
November — because they know that Eugene and Adam will hold Trump to
account.

That’s why I’m urgently asking:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em_vindman.0ZVE-D&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240829_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=7348%2E5257348%2Ers5ICB ]So please, can you split a
$10
contribution between Eugene and Adam’s campaigns today? Every dollar you
give today will help them build the resources they need to win this
November and help us keep the Senate and take back the House majority.

Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**
**[That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $10 between my campaign and Adam Frisch's today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat and win in Colorado. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. = Can I explain something, folks? I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer. Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you so much for sticking by me. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=2959bff737894aa58e936603a0b13c93&_e=Sjx900m1hT9EmqSqIEvO3On8JBT53UX8g-gdoNCoFAyMoLzt0vmZSFJTx06rACBEhUM1eN1-c4n5mtCxt9Au4BSSD36Nw43VYz7OGx0mD3JccsI7jVrJX9p3PU1y1D9JB4_3iQuKBisvR_hN_ygr-18yhLM4rb7dCCrCdv9D-SxsFvbktVRPOLmHlULFcgRM1NAyQkjweu0R2vhRLZY8gJtKmXkOfb9d1i75YB_V2nSmVeRlgA-FYhFBs6gtVke_6VtfiM9YtmPzj8CRGcEEyFbcvxGkwaxYVpdhpDqrtBHsz-eh2U_iPpncmFNYDcxVwUE1A9-l2pUMf_OnsnOk9xUry05l5e0mrVjBmZHjI95SsPoEJQISLjPOxp4u6S0BY3BNrJYqTCmEqClL47dR2-zguAzehumjuTmgKqZ1mpw%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=2959bff737894aa58e936603a0b13c93&_e=Sjx900m1hT9EmqSqIEvO3On8JBT53UX8g-gdoNCoFAyMoLzt0vmZSFJTx06rACBEhUM1eN1-c4n5mtCxt9Au4BSSD36Nw43VYz7OGx0mD3JccsI7jVrJX9p3PU1y1D9JB4_3iQuKBisvR_hN_ygr-18yhLM4rb7dCCrCdv9D-SxsFvbktVRPOLmHlULFcgRM1NAyQkjweu0R2vhRLZY8gJtKmXkOfb9d1i75YB_V2nSmVeRlgA-FYhFBs6gtVke_6VtfiM9YtmPzj8CRGcEEyLOhHdDb8YLIzaXkYa5hINUUKkn8pkqtc3jnAwX34gzkjTihqf6nv2i9MVvjzXUFhWocB1_Ivjjs9R1Cp33tnZHL4tJzsq8WkjaHEsDuNt4HHJxSSso5PIUMHk098bCU8iLL5WAmDK8xSgYW2LUYu5s%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=2959bff737894aa58e936603a0b13c93&_e=Sjx900m1hT9EmqSqIEvO3On8JBT53UX8g-gdoNCoFAyMoLzt0vmZSFJTx06rACBEhUM1eN1-c4n5mtCxt9Au4BSSD36Nw43VYz7OGx0mD3JccsI7jVrJX9p3PU1y1D9JB4_3iQuKBisvR_hN_ygr-18yhLM4rb7dCCrCdv9D-SxsFvbktVRPOLmHlULFcgRM1NAyQkjweu0R2vhRLZY8gJtKmXkOfb9d1i75YB_V2nSmVeRlgA-FYhFBs6gtVke_6VtfiM9YtmPzj8CRGcEEyHB4eGpUtpdKAh_VVZ3hLJD_H7GJiq-xwFckiprq-tfXb-n4-DiLvnhO-dJ9ol9Db3XB6I64rnpt0_THbPgOev5-3aAORx4k_GeQZZyMW-axeLnJPWWjRPle5zbX3Kkuwuioq_nL_M9TqaAa_pGmqV4%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

August 29, 2024
Connecticut residents recently received electric bills with a quaint People's Republic of Connecticut addition: the Public Benefits Charge.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2ce15b0-e4b1-4461-9d61-ee24eb2aec67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Meanwhile, the CEOs of Connecticut's electric companies have been slumming it with Joe Nolan of Eversource pulling in a [paltry $18,800,000](https://substack.com/redirect/6a2eef00-2bb0-45f3-bdbc-5560d5c86ed8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a year while the piker Franklyn Reynolds had to recently apply for Medicaid because of his lowly $1,025,000 salary. No wonder the sales of Louis XIII Cognac are plummeting.
First some background. Electric bills are based on the amount of power a residence uses for items such as refrigerators, air conditioners, computers etc. This unit of power is called a watt (amperes x volts for you physics fans). A laptop will typically use 30 watts per hour.

If you look at your electric bill, you will see the term kilowatt, which simply is 1000 watts. Furthermore, you will see the term kilowatts per hour (kilowatt/hour), which means the amount of power your residence consumes per unit of time.

In Connecticut, the typical electric bill will have a charge of 29 cents per kilowatt/hour and these bills are paid monthly. The average monthly bill in Connecticut is about $400, meaning the average residence uses almost 1,400 kilowatt/hours per month.
Nationally, the average price for a kilowatt/hour [is 16 cents.](https://substack.com/redirect/a5d3c9f6-191a-43e9-85f4-3f6934b55a1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So why is Connecticut's so high? If you listen to the political class and the corporate media, you will hear incomprehensible gibberish such a such as the cost of maintaining the electric grid, the high cost of fossil fuels, the need for bureaucratic reform in Public Utility Regulatory Authority (PURA) by separating it from the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection (DEEP), reallocating unobligated end-of-year American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) funds etc.

Of course this is all nonsense. The reason electricity costs are high is because the Democrats won the election. And one of the most vocal Democratic constituencies is the Climate Change lobby. These people believe manmade behavior via the use of fossil fuels is causing climate change resulting in hotter temperatures and more intense storms.

Never mind that the [hottest year on record is 1933 ](https://substack.com/redirect/acd3d278-54dc-425a-b6c7-2e628a65347d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)(If you don't believe me, read _The Grapes of Wrath_). Never mind that last year, there were about 20,000 deaths worldwide from natural disasters whereas 100 years ago, there were 200,000 deaths - even though the population of the planet was four times less than today. Never mind that the planet was much hotter 1200 years ago and that Greenland (which now has 83% of its surface covered with glaciers) was all green - thus the name.

Never mind that there is no scientific explanation why increasing the CO2 concentration from 200 parts per million (ppm) 100 years ago (yes, CO2 concentration is so low it is measured in parts per million) to 430 parts per million causes the Earth's temperature to rise 1.5 degrees Celsius. Never mind that this prediction is based on computer models that can't predict the weather one week from now. And never mind there has never been an experiment where the CO2 concentration is increased from 200 ppm to 430 ppm in a geodesic dome to test this hypothesis.
Yet the powerful Climate Change lobby pushed our Democratic legislators to require that a minimum amount of power must come from renewables. The problem is that the wind does not always blow, and the sun does not always shine. Thus, when power is needed quickly, Connecticut imports power from fossil fuel producers. And buying this power on short demand is expensive. It's like trying to find a hotel room in Pittsburgh the day before the Steelers' game (unless they are playing the Jets). You may find one. But you are going to pay to the nose.
Thus, electricity rates skyrocketed, and the poor could not afford to pay them. Which means Mr. Nolan and Mr. Reynolds have to buy Boone's Farm for their wine cellar. And we can't have that.
Thus, the Democrats added "The Public Benefits Charge" to your electric bill to subsidize those who cannot afford to pay these high rates.

The Republicans want to call a Special Session to confront this issue, but all they are suggesting is eliminating the Public Benefits Charge and paying the energy bills with tax revenues. But it is unlikely they have the votes for this, let alone eliminating the renewable power mandates - which is what really needs to be done.

So this is just another adventure in the People's Republic of Connecticut, where the poor are hopelessly dependent, the affluent hold their nose and pay the bill and the middle class exits to the rationally governed Republican southern states.

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: how do we fight back against Abbott's voter purge?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Two big moves by Republican leaders this week could alter the outcome of
elections in Texas. But thankfully, there is a way to fight back.

First, Attorney General Ken Paxton’s office conducted a raid on Hispanic
voters and organizers associated with LULAC, the oldest Hispanic civil
rights organization in the country.

The Texas Tribune wrote that:

Gabriel Rosales, Texas LULAC’s state director, said in a statement that
Paxton carried out the raids 11 weeks before the 2024 elections "to
suppress the Latino vote through intimidation and any means necessary to
tilt the electoral process in favor of his political allies."

Agents raided the home of Cecilia Castellano — the Democrat running to
succeed state Rep. Tracy King, D-Uvalde — and confiscated her phone as
part of the search, according to Rosales. Republicans see that seat,
which Gov. Greg Abbott carried by nearly 6 percentage points, as their
best potential state House flip in November.

Law enforcement also searched the homes of at least five other Latino
individuals, all of whom were working on Castellano’s campaign and three
of whom are members of Texas LULAC, Rosales added. LULAC is a
non-partisan, volunteer-based Hispanic civil rights organization
headquartered in Washington.

Second, Governor Greg Abbott bragged on Twitter that Texas had removed 1.1
million names from the Texas voting rolls. While most of those removed had
moved or died, there are many who may have been wrongly deleted.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240829.swAbhE&refcode=ema20240829-239788&t=1001&akid=239788%2E444211%2ECVvRAo ][IMG]

Both of these actions are part of a larger effort to scare certain voters
about participating in November’s election. They’re not about finding
criminality or purifying our elections. They’re about intimidation, pure
and simple.

Imagine if you’ve never voted before, never registered to vote before, and
you read that voters are being purged and voting rights organizations are
being raided. You might think twice about trying to participate in this
election. Or, what if you’re one of those whose names were struck from the
rolls by mistake? What do you do then?

This week, I was registering students with Powered by People on the
campuses of UT Austin, Texas State, UT San Antonio and Texas Southern
University. We registered and confirmed voter registration status for
thousands of young Texans. And we also came across dozens of students who
thought they were registered, only to discover – after we checked their
registration status for them – that they were no longer on the voting
rolls. Our volunteers were able to get them re-registered on the spot and,
importantly, exchanged contact information with each voter to make sure we
could assist them throughout the remainder of this election.

Here's a picture of me talking with one of these purged voters that we got
re-registered this week, Leo from Texas State:

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240829.swAbhE&refcode=ema20240829-239788&t=1002&akid=239788%2E444211%2ECVvRAo ][IMG]

That’s how we fight back against Abbott and Paxton. That’s how we overcome
voter suppression and banana republic scare tactics: hundreds of
volunteers across the state, registering tens of thousands of new voters
and helping to restore the voting rights of those who’ve been wrongly
denied the ability to vote.

At UT San Antonio on Wednesday we stayed outside with students who lined
up for 5 hours straight to get registered to vote – probably the biggest
single day of voter registration for our group. And we still have more
than a month before the voter registration deadline. We won’t stop until
we’ve tried to register, stay in touch with and turn out every eligible
voter out there.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240829.swAbhE&refcode=ema20240829-239788&t=1003&akid=239788%2E444211%2ECVvRAo ][IMG]

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240829.swAbhE&refcode=ema20240829-239788&t=1004&akid=239788%2E444211%2ECVvRAo ]Please consider supporting our effort to fight back by reaching,
registering and turning out Democratic voters who can make the difference
in critical elections.

Thank you,

Beto

They DON'T believe in stripping people of their reproductive rights.
They __ DON'T want to see their taxes go up while the top 1% gets a tax cut. They DON'T _ _ want to lose their Medicare and Social Security benefits.
And they DON'T want leaders who sow division and scapegoat others to stay in power.
But the Florida GOP has spent _years_ gerrymandering our state to ensure that they hold on to power in Tallahassee, while totally ignoring what the majority of Floridians actually want. _They convince us that our blue votes don't matter, to keep poll turnout low and voter disillusionment high._
**And then, the extremists who've gerrymandered their way into office pass more voter suppression bills, making it even harder for voters to cast their ballots with each election year.**
_Why?_

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
ORGANIZING IN ACTION:
Taking a stand for housing justice in Harris County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2024%20Pasadena%20mobile%20home%20action.jpeg]
Residents of Parkview Mobile Home Park in Pasadena are fed up with their living conditions. And rightfully so. They teamed up with TOP for a press conference this past Thursday to bring attention to a disturbing pattern of unjust treatment from their landlord.
Read more about their demands for change. [https://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/housing/2024/08/22/497586/pasadena-residents-in-a-mobile-home-community-voice-concerns-about-new-management/]
TOP believes housing is a human right , and each and every resident of our state -- regardless of their age, race, gender, preferred language, or economic status -- deserves a safe, affordable, and secure place to call home.
Stay tuned as we continue to organize alongside these residents for justice and answers.
For more information on this development and how you can plug in, contact Damaris at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
SURVEY: Organizing for a smarter, more humane probation system in Bexar County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Right2Justice.jpg]
Texas taxpayers are spending huge sums on an inefficient probation system each and every year. We need to reconsider the system to make it safe and effective, not costly and ineffective. More people are on probation in Texas than are serving time in every county jail -- that's 254 counties put together and then multiplied by three. Mounting a statewide intervention to disrupt how probation works in Texas is yet another way we chip away at mass incarceration in our state.
TAKE THIS SURVEY if you're a Bexar County resident, to share with us your thoughts on the county's probation system. [https://secure.everyaction.com/Mshuu6fauEG23vOgLeWFfg2]
For more information about TOP’s Right2Justice work in Bexar County, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Apply & Join Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/We%20are%20hiring%20-%20English.png]
If you or someone you know cares deeply about social justice and transforming our state so Black and Latino Texans have the political power they deserve, then check out TOP’s current job openings [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/] . Don't hesitate to connect us to any talented and passionate community members you may have in mind.
Feel free to email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions or to apply.
TOP Tips: Protect yourself. Get free at-home COVID tests.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rapid%20test%20stock%20photo.jpg]
Don't take this new COVID variant lightly. While COVID hospitalizations thankfully remain low compared to previous summer waves of the virus, we have to keep our guard up. Come September, put your name down for free at-home COVID tests from the federal government, whether you have health insurance or not. [https://www.axios.com/2024/08/23/free-covid-test-kits-return-september-2024-usps]
Español
ORGANIZANDO:
Tomando una postura a favor de la justicia habitacional en el condado de Harris
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2024%20Pasadena%20mobile%20home%20action.jpeg]
Los residentes de Parkview Mobile Home Park en Pasadena están hartos de sus condiciones de vida. Y con toda razón. Se unieron con TOP para una conferencia de prensa el pasado jueves para llamar la atención sobre un patrón inquietante de trato injusto por parte de su arrendador.
Lea más sobre sus demandas de cambio. [https://www.telemundohouston.com/noticias/local/desalojos-casas-moviles-pasadena/2428892/]
TOP cree que la vivienda es un derecho humano y que todos y cada uno de los residentes de nuestro estado, independientemente de su edad, raza, género, idioma preferido o situación económica, merecen un lugar seguro, asequible y protegido al que llamar hogar.
Manténgase atento mientras continuamos organizándonos junto con estos residentes para lograr justicia y respuestas.
Para obtener más información sobre este desarrollo y cómo puede participar, comuníquese con Damaris en dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
ENCUESTA: Organizándose para un sistema de libertad condicional más inteligente y humano en el condado de Bexar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Right2Justice.jpg]
Los contribuyentes de Texas están gastando enormes sumas de dinero en un sistema de libertad condicional ineficiente cada año. Necesitamos reconsiderar el sistema para hacerlo seguro y efectivo, no costoso e ineficaz. Hay más personas en libertad condicional en Texas que cumpliendo condena en todas las cárceles del condado, lo que equivale a los 254 condados juntos y luego multiplicado por tres. Montar una intervención a nivel estatal para interrumpir el funcionamiento de la libertad condicional en Texas es otra forma de reducir la encarcelación masiva en nuestro estado.
RESPONDA ESTA ENCUESTA si es residente del condado de Bexar para compartir con nosotros sus opiniones sobre el sistema de libertad condicional del condado. [https://secure.everyaction.com/Mshuu6fauEG23vOgLeWFfg2]
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo Right2Justice de TOP en el condado de Bexar, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Solicite unirse al Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Spanish%20-%20we%20are%20hiring.png]
Si tú o alguien que conoces se preocupa profundamente por la justicia social y transformar nuestro estado para que los tejanos negros y latinos tengan el poder político que merecen, echa un vistazo a las ofertas de trabajo actuales de TOP. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/] No dudes en conectarnos con cualquier miembro talentoso y apasionado de la comunidad que tengas en mente.
No dudes en enviar un correo electrónico a recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] con cualquier pregunta o para postularte.
Consejos de TOP: Protégete a ti mismo. Obtenga pruebas de COVID gratuitas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Rapid%20test%20stock%20photo.jpg]
No tomes a la ligera esta nueva variante de COVID. Aunque, afortunadamente, las hospitalizaciones por COVID siguen siendo bajas en comparación con las olas anteriores del virus en verano, debemos mantenernos en alerta. En septiembre, regístrate para recibir pruebas gratuitas de COVID en casa del gobierno federal, ya sea que tengas seguro de salud o no. [https://www.axios.com/2024/08/23/free-covid-test-kits-return-september-2024-usps]

For more information on this development and how you can plug in, contact Damaris at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] . SURVEY: Organizing for a smarter, more humane probation system in Bexar County [] Texas taxpayers are spending huge sums on an inefficient probation system each and every year. We need to reconsider the system to make it safe and effective, not costly and ineffective. More people are on probation in Texas than are serving time in every county jail -- that's 254 counties put together and then multiplied by three. Mounting a statewide intervention to disrupt how probation works in Texas is yet another way we chip away at mass incarceration in our state. TAKE THIS SURVEY if you're a Bexar County resident, to share with us your thoughts on the county's probation system. [] For more information about TOP’s Right2Justice work in Bexar County, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] . Apply & Join Team Teal [] If you or someone you know cares deeply about social justice and transforming our state so Black and Latino Texans have the political power they deserve, then check out TOP’s current job openings [] . Don't hesitate to connect us to any talented and passionate community members you may have in mind. Feel free to email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions or to apply. TOP Tips: Protect yourself. Get free at-home COVID tests. [] Don't take this new COVID variant lightly. While COVID hospitalizations thankfully remain low compared to previous summer waves of the virus, we have to keep our guard up. Come September, put your name down for free at-home COVID tests from the federal government, whether you have health insurance or not. [] Español ORGANIZANDO: Tomando una postura a favor de la justicia habitacional en el condado de Harris [] Los residentes de Parkview Mobile Home Park en Pasadena están hartos de sus condiciones de vida. Y con toda razón. Se unieron con TOP para una conferencia de prensa el pasado jueves para llamar la atención sobre un patrón inquietante de trato injusto por parte de su arrendador. Lea más sobre sus demandas de cambio. [] TOP cree que la vivienda es un derecho humano y que todos y cada uno de los residentes de nuestro estado, independientemente de su edad, raza, género, idioma preferido o situación económica, merecen un lugar seguro, asequible y protegido al que llamar hogar. Manténgase atento mientras continuamos organizándonos junto con estos residentes para lograr justicia y respuestas. Para obtener más información sobre este desarrollo y cómo puede participar, comuníquese con Damaris en dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] . ENCUESTA: Organizándose para un sistema de libertad condicional más inteligente y humano en el condado de Bexar [] Los contribuyentes de Texas están gastando enormes sumas de dinero en un sistema de libertad condicional ineficiente cada año. Necesitamos reconsiderar el sistema para hacerlo seguro y efectivo, no costoso e ineficaz. Hay más personas en libertad condicional en Texas que cumpliendo condena en todas las cárceles del condado, lo que equivale a los 254 condados juntos y luego multiplicado por tres. Montar una intervención a nivel estatal para interrumpir el funcionamiento de la libertad condicional en Texas es otra forma de reducir la encarcelación masiva en nuestro estado. RESPONDA ESTA ENCUESTA si es residente del condado de Bexar para compartir con nosotros sus opiniones sobre el sistema de libertad condicional del condado. [] Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo Right2Justice de TOP en el condado de Bexar, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] . Solicite unirse al Team Teal [] Si tú o alguien que conoces se preocupa profundamente por la justicia social y transformar nuestro estado para que los tejanos negros y latinos tengan el poder político que merecen, echa un vistazo a las ofertas de trabajo actuales de TOP. [] No dudes en conectarnos con cualquier miembro talentoso y apasionado de la comunidad que tengas en mente. No dudes en enviar un correo electrónico a recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] con cualquier pregunta o para postularte. Consejos de TOP: Protégete a ti mismo. Obtenga pruebas de COVID gratuitas [] No tomes a la ligera esta nueva variante de COVID. Aunque, afortunadamente, las hospitalizaciones por COVID siguen siendo bajas en comparación con las olas anteriores del virus en verano, debemos mantenernos en alerta. subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| | Dear Friend,Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-hDnghROvPgF4jg)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)**[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._FKAdDO9ZpD6G3iF6XcKQ), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers--one from each scholar--written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. **[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** Thanks,Greg Greg Stamps | Online DevelopmentHoover Institution | Stanford University
---
_With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research organization that seeks to improve the human condition by advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world._

body:

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie

body:
Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin here.

When Virginians elected me in 2021, it sent a shockwave across the country and proved that commonsense conservative leadership can win anywhere in America.

Virginians hired an outsider and businessman as their Governor to help put Virginia back on the path to prosperity. We lowered taxes, created jobs, reclaimed the honor of America's Top State for Business, put parents back at the head seat of the table in their children's lives, and provided record funding for our students, teachers, and law enforcement heroes.

This positive change would not have been possible without committed, hardworking voters who devoted their time, energy, and resources to winning that historic election in 2021.

In 2024, we have another historic opportunity to make positive change for the entire country by electing Donald J. Trump as President and sending a Republican Majority to the United States Senate.

Even in Virginia, a state Joe Biden won by 10 points in 2020, we are seeing a competitive presidential race and an opportunity to flip a critical Senate seat too.

But we cannot do this without you.

We know Vice President Harris and Senate Democrats will raise hundreds of millions of dollars to win in November. If we let them outpace us in energy and resources, we will get the same failed policies of the last four years for the next four years. We won't secure our southern border, we won't bring down the cost of living, and we won't restore peace through strength around the world.

**[That is why I am asking you to please make a contribution of any amount to help Republicans win in November with a strong Republican Senate Majority to support a President Trump agenda.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5sa8j3ouhamu1hho2p2rkrr27rqhnt3tmtmliio_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c1i6aor5cdh2bs)**

Trust me, I have seen what happens when everyone gets off the sidelines and gets in the game to make positive change with commonsense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we did in 2021 for Virginia and, with your help, we can do it again in 2024 for America.

Thank you for your commitment and your support.

name: John Pierce
subject: Deadline Looming for the “Praying Grandma”
body:
On September 12th, Rebecca Lavrenz must pay her fine of $103,000 to the Biden/Harris Justice Department.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zld5rqeeivj0e5baqtotjjiopkeggudfgrvo8gt8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c1i69oj6cdh2bs)

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8dhi23qc7oifvv51v1h3gv6l1tl4ev6av7u6pf0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c1i69oj6cdh2bs) Dear Patriot,

On September 12th, Rebecca Lavrenz must pay her fine of $103,000 to the Biden/Harris Justice Department.

Rebecca is the 72-year-old great-grandmother and faithful Christian who entered the Capital building with a group for several minutes, caused no harm, and left when she was asked.

**[Please help Rebecca pay this outrageous fine and the cost of her appeal.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zulrk8nr9kj6kcvkj2p7hf60emjgsveljbk5ubmg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c1i69oj6cdh2bs)**

Mrs. Lavrenz was sentenced to six months of house arrest, 12 months of probation, and the largest fine for a misdemeanor in history--$103,000!

As her attorney, I knew a guilty verdict was impossible to avoid given the politics of this case, so I fought hard to avoid jail time for Rebecca.

While we succeeded in keeping a great-grandmother out of jail, Judge Zia Faruqui wanted to make an example of Rebecca and silence her voice ahead of the November elections, so in addition to the fine and punishment, he added a provision that Rebecca is BANNED from the Internet.

She cannot use email, post on X or Facebook, or log in to join a podcast.

Rebecca cannot even access the online reservation system for her bed and breakfast, her primary source of income.

She needs our help to pay this looming fine and cover the costs of the appeal we are working on, **[so please donate as much as you can today to ensure Rebecca is not penalized even more for failing to pay the fine](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm27otp47v3o1dn9uuks8acpcot0p51pubp988lo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c1i69oj6cdh2bs).**

Since Rebecca is banned from the Internet by Judge Faruqui, I wanted to share her words directly with you:

| ❝
---
Saddened that the current government administration and 'justice' system who call themselves the 'United States of America' want to silence me by sentencing me to home detention and banning me from the Internet for six months, but grateful that family and a multitude of others are now stepping up to carry my voice further to 'Make America Godly Again'!

\- Rebecca Lavrenz

Since graduating from Harvard Law, I have been a top litigator, representing cases worth billions of dollars. My organization, the National Constitutional Law Union, has represented dozens of January 6th defendants to the best of our ability.

In my decades as an attorney, I have never experienced such brazen words from a judge to a defendant. Judge Faruqui called into question Rebecca's Christian values and even her dedication to her children and grandchildren.

His words still echo in my head, and I must share them again.

During sentencing, Judge Faruqui looked at Rebecca and scolded her by saying, "I don't know why being the J6 Praying Grandmother is more important than being an actual grandmother." He then said, "Your faith is being misplaced right now."

**Faruqui, a member of the Board of Advisors of Muslim American Public Service, took shots at Rebecca's Christian faith, which was not appropriate in any setting.**

Yet Rebecca stood fast by responding, "**While I respect you, I answer to a higher judge**."

As Americans and as Christians, we must help Rebecca meet her deadline and pay this fine, **[so please donate today so we can fully focus on our appeal](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zccoj5d9u89p9ki5rmu07hcdnacnqf5q88shmvb8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c1i69oj6cdh2bs)** - **which I will take to the Supreme Court of the United States if I have to.**

**[Please donate to help Rebecca now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zervquusi1pk0a9vammnol9k2mka3j5s4vh07na0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5c1i69oj6cdh2bs)**

We must help Rebecca Lavrenz. She is one of us. She is a typical American who loves her country and is willing to fight for it. However, because she entered the Capital on the wrong day and caused no harm, the Biden/Harris regime has targeted her as a person who poses "a threat to future acts of political violence."

Is the Biden/Harris Administration THAT terrified of a little 72-year-old grandmother, or are they sending a message to the rest of us?

J.D. Vance was born in Middletown, Ohio, into a family that faced the economic struggles and societal challenges often felt by working-class Americans. Raised by his grandmother in a household that emphasized hard work, faith, and perseverance, J.D. developed a deep understanding of the issues plaguing rural America. His early life experiences shaped his unwavering commitment to defending the values of family, community, and patriotism that are the bedrock of conservative ideology.

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z09tkbk9h6sp3u1evv9tengk9b6v1k0n65lr8a68_)

After graduating from high school, J.D. Vance enlisted in the United States Marine Corps, where he served honorably in Iraq. His time in the military further instilled in him the values of discipline, leadership, and a love for his country. J.D.'s military service is a testament to his dedication to protecting American freedoms and upholding the principles that have made the United States a beacon of liberty around the world.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z613tjb3889t87660g46ac1to78uctop5vrdv788_)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbt57it4aov2e2hu4fm54br9u1jtft002rv26duo_)

Upon returning from Iraq, J.D. Vance pursued higher education with the same tenacity he had shown throughout his life. He graduated from Ohio State University and went on to earn a law degree from Yale Law School, one of the most prestigious institutions in the country. J.D.'s rise from humble beginnings to the heights of academic and professional success is a powerful example of the American Dream, proving that through hard work and determination, anyone can achieve greatness in this great nation.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl1m1oid9pskhu1g4a1itoeflbditcpih8r6jaj8_)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5esjo15putj5n7pccllft343decre991vk1mljg_)

In 2016, J.D. Vance published his bestselling memoir, *Hillbilly Elegy*, which resonated with millions of Americans across the country. The book not only told the story of his own life but also shed light on the struggles of working-class Americans in the Rust Belt. J.D.'s ability to articulate the challenges faced by many in forgotten communities made him a prominent voice in conservative circles, as he championed the need for policies that uplift and empower all Americans.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2za7lf41jdnksclqgrhlbpntov4qkmolhtt8c4mao_)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd7pr6g24kig3hj68gj17fgmk0fvpje6tpo472jo_)

J.D. Vance's deep understanding of the challenges facing everyday Americans led him to enter the political arena, where he quickly aligned himself with President Donald Trump's America First agenda. J.D. recognized that President Trump's policies brought back jobs, strengthened national security, and put American interests first. His support for Trump is rooted in a shared vision of a stronger, more prosperous America where the voices of the working class are heard and respected.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrfbf8l5gk4n906t9tp7t5a591rlqefs80n1ldh0_)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zo4q0evpk79bhlsd61gb7bbhkipsgqccihqdr4bg_)

In 2022, J.D. Vance was elected as the United States Senator from Ohio, representing the values and interests of the people of his state with courage and conviction. As a senator, J.D. has been a staunch advocate for conservative principles, fighting against big government overreach and championing policies that protect American jobs, strengthen our borders, and ensure that our nation remains the land of opportunity for all.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z315q6o9gcq9jjn29a0nu42dvo3s8i91p8fvcju0_)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zub89a5sa618u5t2t1nuhidvfehrqhtmncvcl2eg_)

Fast forward to July 15, 2024: J.D. Vance is selected as Donald Trump's running mate for Vice President of the United States. With his deep roots in the heartland, military service, and a track record of advocating for the working-class Americans who have felt left behind, J.D. is the perfect complement to Trump's America First agenda. Together, they represent a powerful force for change, ready to restore American greatness by standing up for the values of faith, family, and freedom that define our nation.
**[SUPPORT TRUMP-VANCE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zprae7sk7o1g32um1paj8b19dkf44c9o39s1c7jg_)**
---

* * *

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8i5qvip4qek6scen3ckogl4j72bakdn8ede93v8_)

Well, that's J.D. Vance in a nutshell. If you're still reading this, thank YOU! There is a lot of fake news out there and the lies coming from the leftist media are never ending. It's important you hear the TRUTH, which is that J.D.'s selection as Trump's running mate is a testament to his unwavering commitment to conservative principles and his vision for a prosperous, secure, and united America.

Together, they WILL Make America Great Again, but only with your help. Every dollar counts, and we'd really appreciate it.

# [Demand Trump apologize to veterans and be punished for his disgraceful performance at Arlington National Cemetery](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbf614c3a-3ec1-4eef-b3a7-ad7b015f62a4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | It takes a special kind of jerk to go to the sacred space of Arlington National Cemetery, use it as a campaign prop, and flash a thumbs up in front of a tombstone while illegally taking pictures and film for ads. **Donald Trump is that jerk. And it's not surprising that veterans across America are [livid](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc41e5bbb-dcfd-49d8-8dcb-80b2273739ec/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9).** Trump needs to apologize, and he needs to do it immediately. And since what he did is against federal law, according to cemetery officials, he needs to be punished. If Trump really cared about the grieving families who were there, as he claims, he wouldn't have used them as campaign props. There's no excuse for this, and he needs to admit what he did was wrong, and face the consequences. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: finally . . . it’s over
body:
That was the worst DNC I’ve ever seen...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’ve been thinking a lot about the Democratic National Convention since it ended last week and what it means for America.

Of course, I imagined the DNC would be radical and unhinged . . .

But they sunk even lower than my bottomed-out expectations.

The "Hotties for Harris" afterparty was complete with abortion-themed games like a gumball machine that dispensed _Plan B_ and even a skee-ball abortion game.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtuuiyd-duchtdja-y/)
The mob of abortion radicals wearing Chemical Abortion Pill costumes in the streets of Chicago was super gross.

But the worst part was _Planned Parenthood_ bringing their mobile killing unit and ending the lives of at least 25 preborn babies _(that they bragged about!)_ right outside the venue!

Yet, no one is calling out the Democrats for this evil?

Where are our supposed pro-life allies in office? Why are they so silent in the face of evil?

Pro-Life Friend, _Students for Life Action_ will not be silent. In fact, we're actively calling on the GOP to stop putting their heads in the sand and letting the insanity of their pro-abortion counterparts go unnoticed.

Plus, with your help, we’re running this targeted ad calling out Kamala Harris, who spent part of her nomination acceptance speech telling outright lies about abortion and expressing how "proud" she would be to force limitless abortion on America.

But I’m counting on your generous contribution to help me keep it running.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtuuiyd-duchtdja-j/)

These sick and evil people have shown us their true colors, Pro-Life Friend.

What happened at the Democratic National Convention has made it clearer than ever where they stand.

This is what we’re up against this November.

So, with everything on the line in 2024, **[I’m hoping I can count on you to chip in to keep our ad running and help us defeat them](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtuuiyd-duchtdja-t/).**

Because what you and I saw at the DNC is exactly what our country will look like if we lose.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

## Debate Rules Set for Trump and Kamala
ABC News has agreed with former President Trump that there will be [no audience, muted mics, and no written notes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAQQH-N3RENAw64oLgmXa690uJjiOeEjYVJov33q2y95dNrnt6_-3L3XHh__PUbuZ7r4mPnFy1WKBCoFz0ml4mQ1EhOGpwAp9nIcXUxTKTnKUurYsiUvYdIGn0Iyqrk1cgOATVYBRLAgLxMV5NykIQBY7ASBw2UuNd2-V957yvl8lVf1C6xbmNxa-_HOag_A94GvPljp_f5UR9onWOhAW-rb41P0dtzO0Si4DsJH6LYnp2S2Di2eqx1p1NQodi57gJUitJcfbQhBG3yHKVNmqwOEmYCPTaXjjeXwufVDBoem-fy09R_P_Ry-B0AAP__2ENpfw) for the Sept. 10 debate between the two candidates.Trump and Harris will stand on a stage and will [only be allowed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O5CAQhJ8GZz2CNv4LCC5xtpdeaDXQHrMLtgV4Vvv2J0-82Sd9UlWp_n0sHxRi2J9_KbGp67GQq-HFywitBNSLbrxZmZHbho0asJPYTYNqNuNHcqq1XvWyI4ma2lXT1BOuo9UtTU0wKFHLsZVKykGqR9cPfrWK0aKzo0KhJftQj_z4PMJeN17jz_Hi_HBHaqLZaj2LaP8InAXO-895lHorgfMdLHCW482TwPkqsPN3ETiTdW-EzJ_saoEvShQJNso5FIhUKqSwX5XBBg_1ALfR_mSo-UoneLZUGfIVucB3iBG-mE9IV2UPKbi7osnGn7cLpR-Els9EIb5H198vfBn8HwAA__-JK3RZ) to have a pen, a pad of paper, and a bottle of water. The rules are essentially the same as in the June debate between Trump and President Biden.The debate is scheduled for 90 minutes, and the candidates must stand behind podiums and are not permitted to ask questions of each other or interact with campaign staff.The Harris campaign [had previously pushed back](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u7CAQQOGngY4VjMHYBcVt3O1tU1r8jJeJwKxs4lXePkqkdKm_4kjn7b7ePRXaH_99Rde3tvrY6cJ1EoMUoFfNk9sQAQeOTlkwEsxsFc8O5DzGyWoYR2_QGzQwa7XNXs5DSEFxciBBy2mQSkor1c2MNm1BIQSIYVLAtMREvR2390Z7z7iVz3bhcYut8uJy78-TDf8YLAyWnjFTKd_GYMmt4o6vk8ESfX16euwMFj0ZrawR2R8HneJXhA9RJAy-o6gfHZOoFBks_HDp-aJS6Bwt0_JRPf0EeP97xeXgKwAA___oJGAG) on the rules by demanding the use of live mics throughout the broadcast, raising questions about whether Trump would participate.
## Listeria Linked to Deli Meat Kills 9
Nine people have died in [a listeria outbreak](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1yqzAQQOGnEd0yYvl1ocKNOt_2lswiLWZjIXmEbJK3zyR16tOc-f7f5htJkHj_RzubsqaZXJE3zxO0GrCbu8qblRm5rdg0I_Ya-8vYVJsZsHcaJ-onGnzviBz7bhqwX9xlHUlXYlBjp6dWN1qPuqn7YfTr0jAu6JapQdVp9lJSrj-SxLLxGr7Sm3Pt0l4Fs5XyPFR7VWgV2vM86_2IP02h5QivQ6HdmELZFNqdvTgKCq3zDi4Q0wmeyYNECHIUzkKQXmXJTA8IEh_soSTwHAR2pqLQUobrtXlayp9VNv55SghyDKPq9H0nCb9f5W-lt8HvAAAA__-KQmqZ) linked to recalled Boar's Head deli meat, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported Wednesday.The outbreak has sickened at least 57 people across 18 states, with all cases requiring hospitalization.CDC officials say it's the [largest listeria outbreak since 2011](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L-O4yAQgPGnwR3WMDZxUlBc4y7XXmnxZ4jngk0EJE7efrVbb_9Jn_T7d12ulhPvt792I9NiXqxv_KLlLAeQOC5jF0wkQho6MmpCDagvk-pWQw6VDVFfIE4D-FNUWoHyjrRS3nvdsUHAEc4DKIAJVK9PU4hOETr07qxQjECBWy79_8x7WymmT35R6X3eumTW1h5VDH8EzgLn4zj6mN_uWXmnWr8bgXPiSLV9EgmcK7_llgvJQLatVSbe7xSky7ZUuZINMnFtVNjK_GyukL13xYTHwSlxPU1ihNtmOf3s2-8YL4NfAQAA__9bvmRm) and warn more people are likely affected beyond confirmed cases.Boar's Head has recalled 7 million pounds of products from its Virginia facility, and health officials urge consumers to check for recalled meats and [thoroughly clean potentially contaminated](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3hwdBwf2wNAlW7p2tIA7YioSRxgl6t9X6dzx6Q1Pel-X9RJKLffrZ7iJ73lfQ-rlKes8aZjQrGZkn0VQ9CheOSRAWpwaN49sF3Y5OSGKTDM5p2wIYJi1zo7H4hHQwKxBAThQJ7KOc1SCEVOcFQ4GhEvf2-l7L_e-Sa4_-1PaKe23sfqt98cx6I8BzwOew-Mur-Ot3tB6SVUGPNdydGklTHEP7Zg2CTw1SaHWicktMxGSMSraRJwzawXOLhHEJhqb58er1FoO6wYD11so9a_d_z_x9PgbAAD__8ohXrk) surfaces.

Los Angeles Dodgers [superstar Shohei Ohtani and his dog Decoy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3hydDzD2wNAlW7p2tA44wlXERDZy1L-v0rnj0xue9L5u642kyHb_pAe7lupKocnJ6zwoGFCvuo8uMSOrnt1o0QCaxY59dgsjoY4UDcIECm3QJppoFWlDKUEvDgE1zApGAAvjxUw2Jj8yegx-HrHTwFFa3S_fVbaWOZWfevJ-CfXRF5dbex6d-ujw2uGVnhu_jrd6w94kFO7weuSaWYaaG20y-Op94cwUB0UaDU6KwCxLUpNaDFo1U6BgmRn73cXnS0qRY7KdhvuDpPyV2_8fToe_AQAA__-4RF24) threw out the first pitch on Ohtani bobblehead night, drawing a massive crowd and causing traffic jams around Dodger Stadium.Decoy, a Dutch Kooikerhondje, wore a Dodgers uniform, grabbed the ceremonial ball in his mouth, and delivered it to Ohtani, squatting behind home plate. name: Adam Schiff
subject: I need your help
body:
| | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc4a3f2ef-78d5-4a68-9f1c-0abed68df45f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| | |
---
| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9bce673c-ddf9-43d7-8d2e-5e6b802f7d5c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter — We are just 1 day from our end-of-month fundraising deadline. [Before I explain why this deadline is so important, will you chip in a split donation of $25 between Blue Amp Action and my campaign today to support my campaign?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T28d27d4f-d8ee-43b3-96de-9ddd1f675eb6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | | [DONATE $25 NOW →](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfa0b8bcb-fe67-4a59-9fde-9220cedeb374/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | We are just over 2 months from the election, which means that we don’t have time to fall behind on our fundraising goals. Hitting each fundraising goal, or falling short, will produce one of two possible narratives — that grassroots Democrats are doing everything possible to defeat Republicans this November, or if we’re leaving the door cracked open for a GOP wave this November. I’m going to be honest with you — we are a bit behind on our goal this month. But I’m not worried because I know I can rely on this team to always show up. From the beginning of my campaign, I’ve counted on our team to fuel our efforts to fight against the extreme MAGA agenda and build the biggest grassroots movement California has ever seen. This team has gotten me this far, and I know they can carry me through the election. [With all of this being said, will you rush a split donation today between Blue Amp Action and my campaign to get us back on track to reach our end-of-month fundraising goal? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbd91e43b-9b38-415d-ad80-f310b0387711/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [DONATE $25 NOW →](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta756c648-8b31-4549-98a4-890eccd6a6fa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| We can’t give the GOP any leverage to say that this campaign is weak or losing momentum. With your help, we won’t. Thank you for everything. — Adam
---

---|---
| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

## Environmental Group Sues Texas Over Anti-ESG Law
A nonprofit group sued Texas officials Thursday to block a 2021 [law that restricts state investments](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGuqzAMhp8mbKmCgQaGDHfJ1rueESXEaS2FpCKGtm9_RPez2fqkz_7_n9t8c5Qo3_-7FQ2_Y5ndwnTgPMpOSejnvgnGqzC1DZpWw6BADQM0D-MHmMLS60njOPVxGlFHH_XVB621x64hAwp6NXaqVcO1Gy4ez22JS4zBDS2IXmEgLtuFH8j4djWmTzlwuyxlbZJ5MD-r6P4JsAJs_jxL5RMJsKdZgFXjOU8CrN8rZaxVgP2aZN0xSP-RmA_aSl4xs0vyG44qy_OM3PNScmXinankE2cmifUuk3sJsM1mwvNFKVG9atGr--oofZ_jP7o6DPwGAAD__68lbh4) with firms deemed to "boycott" the oil and gas industry. The American Sustainable Business Council argues the law violates free speech rights by discriminating against businesses that [support reduced fossil fuel reliance](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OgzAQhJ_GdEbrxQZSuLiGLtdeiTZ4HVYyOIp9-Xn7E-mvHGlmPun7Oc9nkiT79Zs29vUV80xLlQfPo-5Ao51tE_wFwsk07M2ADhCcw2b19oR9GMbhMrqR0TA6PPUxUuwAiHpsxCOghbEDA67vXHvhIy1xiTGQM6gscJCa721dufKLSkzv_OB7u-StSX6t9VZU96VwUjhF2WlfuH3TmvPRUDjt_CwKp89W5xhlEUpFl18O-jjStFfRxiJA7wy2a91Sc_fh9pSUpPSDsnDdSNKHWP8R8PD4FwAA___1ul2Z). Texas Comptroller Glenn Hegar maintains a list of companies and funds banned from state investments due to their environmental policies. The lawsuit comes as similar anti-ESG laws face legal challenges in other states.
## Texas A&M Planning Major Campus Projects
Texas A&M University is planning [major campus improvement projects](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAYhJ8Gb1g_P5DYA0MXb-na0cKAYxoICKidvn3l7N3udNKn0_d1m2_aB_-8f-roVHutadam-d3NA-VAUcyis2oBO7LOKXZFCQhSYrcpAD0AMrM4iYyzZbSrMIPhI2doncDOKwQUMHBgIC9c9os7m1nNulotGRIBzvqWSt8219xL1zX8pt2V3qTYBbW1livhHwQngtNxHP1jaa9zJDidbIITDGceCU5vANWR3ks62kZr1uVRaQ76WWnU36lQo2P-qdTHXNLuonu2SnDqirL58CH4erkSAfeofXhfaP8Y2RX-BQAA____AmNW) to accommodate its 71,000 students, an enrollment figure that makes it the second-largest university in the country. Two studies have recommended a [5-year pause on undergraduate growth](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L1u8yAUxvGrwZut48OH8cDw6pW8pUOXjhaGQ4IEwcI0Tu6-SveOj57hJ_2_LuvFxhTv1w-bybRnKKt1LT5o1T2HHsUqOm828PPYkRknlIAgJXY3s83jjEE4ofWspZI6OM4nDYGLWW1SddEgoADNYQSpuBw2ei8XXAjeyhGZAPKxlTq0GzV62iOkV3lQHVzJXTK31vaD8X8MF4bLeZ7D4Wrc_PtmuPjivjPdG8NlUnxG0AoZLm-0_29362J79Z-0l9oY8lBLXilv5Ltq_H7GlOKhJibgmm1Mv2T7o8DD4E8AAAD__05MXBc), along with adding 2,500 on-campus beds, expanding dining facilities by 28,000 square feet, and constructing a $130 million classroom building. The university is also considering "The Aggie Loop," an underground electric transit system estimated to cost $250-$350 million. School officials are [asking for feedback](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFvszAQxvFPY29B57MNZPDwLgyvlC6V2hEd9jm4NYWAQ5NvX9G940969Ej_90t_oZTT1_WFJnblEeeefEk79-1JwwlNb2RwA4SzkuxUgxYQrEU5Oow0RB1a0nUTGlS-YW2Vbw3xWYVhkMkhoIFWgwJba1sNfMhHH2Mgq1AY4JDKvFZl5MIP2mJ-zjuvlZ8nmd1YyrIJ_U9gJ7ArNN2r251yWZPfjonA7iOywC7O64HXt56uz_18M3UH_01ePuXqwvKdck5b3QgD14lS_n0vf8TuDn8CAAD__3HjV3c) on the plans from the campus community and the public by September 17.
## Houston's Buffalo Bayou Park Expanded
Houston's Buffalo Bayou Park [is being extended](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOtCAUhZ8GOwxcYXQKivkLu_nbLc0VLyNZBCOoM2-_cfstzzk5yZfv6zk80QcfX_9xIVPeLg1oiz9o6HgjOKhBVZMZxXSXFRnZghYgtIZqNq3EdrTaWadbKe8NjuKmOql055RWUlXegAAlukZIoW-Nrke6knXWuQm1BKYETb6krS4zFXpjduGTDtpqm5YqmLmUNbPmwaBn0J_nWS85XhuDniLfM4N-SZE-DHqblhWjp6sbd-cwJD7iJ-18xa1E2vLsV44xpj1ayjzSySc6KKR1oVgyL4nTu1CcrsM3gx43_njI9d_WlGoz03r6EHy-tUyJ14I-_EKWP5wdBn4CAAD__1FlcWk) into the Fifth Ward and East End neighborhoods as part of a 10-year master plan supported by a $100 million donation from the Kinder Foundation in 2022. The [Lockwood on Buffalo Bayou](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GO6yAQheGngQ4LBojtguI27nLbLa2xgRgFZyKM7eTtVxttu-WRPuno_7qOV0w5PW7_cQ2uviKNONd0hLETWgowo-HeTdL3igenWrASpLXAF9eDvZi2C972IRrVIqLuY6vBd5NWVvPkQIKRnZZK2ou2zRR-1hznGD1aBczI4FOl0tQl1PDCLeY3HaE0M608u6XW58b0PwYDg2HaY8RME75pb6jcGAy0F3FSuTMYMs33k8gLeohfKT6UwcCL888z5Zy2S8uMvK2Y8uej_pF8OPgOAAD__z4gWfo) affordable housing development was completed in June, and Phase 1 of Japhet Creek Park will open on September 21. Upcoming projects include Phase 2 of Japhet Creek Park and two pedestrian trails, slated for completion in 2027. In recent years, the nonprofit Buffalo Bayou Partnership has been acquiring former industrial properties to create more community green spaces. A summary of the Buffalo Bayou East master plan [can be viewed here](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2K3DAUhZ9G7q65vpLt3UJFDHE3YSFFSGWu9TMjkC1jyeOdtw9O0m5z4HzwweH8uk03DjGs9x-8OF0-fZrYlPB00xtIBFKTqqye0b43ldNNTy0Sti1VD20Mdp2XnVLcK-yxV2x9Y71te5Sy4ypoQlL4JrHBtpNtPburGW-8t9w2JBQ6G0ra6_JwxX1y9vGVnm6vTVqqqB-lbFnIb4JGQeN5nvV8eM8xzfxKR532-4U3MGktbi2CxmOLiW0WNBKSFDTiFcPwAcM_E4ZLhe-cC9w4F7fDR-QVfh7LwvsLGoTfjv_DMawcgTMkD-9ABCYt2-5ydrberK92bbczxBhy1wuF94VD_Du9fPHkU9OfAAAA__8os3X3).

Friend -- The [Hudson River School of Painting](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=CVTZRBnoUghdPvUJk2Qubs3dn-rJVig7f3Lc4PlM7vjQUQqlFl8tXC1v11BH6VbZKEmZqyJ6ejMhSnocrZI1lA&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240830_symposium&n=2) influenced a unique movement in art, literature and science in 19th century America. Two historic monuments in New York State, the home of Thomas Cole (1801-1848) in Catskill and the Olana home of Frederic Church (1826-1900) in Hudson, NY, are excellent introductions to the work of this American cultural association, which was inspired by a broad range of collaborators, from Alexander von Humboldt to James Fenimore Cooper. Then what happened? Fox Green, founder of Space Commune ([spacecommune.com](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=HdUteQQhqqy_ONtnP6f65ceu4GR_gsC7tU7SHMHKVjQ&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240830_symposium&n=3)) and [NY Energy Alliance](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=qvulstcA35QFaAnuYcsGXVPDuIi_APNLQwmeelktGZg&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240830_symposium&n=4) will present comprehensive evidence of the modern subversion of Thomas Cole's legacy, where his patriotic and Promethean ethos have been twisted into support of degrowth. This subversion can be disproved simply by assessing Thomas Cole's own paintings and writings.

It’s these leaders who will have the most direct effect on communities like yours. But state legislative campaigns are constantly overlooked and underfunded. In an ultra-competitive presidential election year, our candidates are competing for press, volunteers, ad space, and donors against races at the top of the ticket. name: Kari Lake
subject: I need you to make a sacrifice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kari Lake for Senate
body:
->->

Fellow American,

I hate doing this, but I'm about to ask you to make a sacrifice before midnight... Before I ask you, I want you to know I wouldn't ask you to do something I myself wouldn't do in your shoes.

Now, let me explain.

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I never expected the establishment operatives out east to try so desperately to stop people like me. All I've ever done is love my country.

Worst of all have been the sacrifices I've made throughout my time running for office. The toll it's taken has been indescribable.

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, \*\*even if it does hurt my pride having to ask you for help. ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3522724.648.1.d3e0245c95a244ef4447007428f25d86 )\*\*

I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Patriot, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Unless conservatives like you and I stand up and make a difference, we won't have a chance at beating my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and his puppet master, Kamala Harris, at the ballot boxes on November 5th.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Patriot. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

My staff has shared these links with me, which you can click on to donate. It will take a maximum of five minutes.

\*\*I WILL SACRIFICE $25 TO SAVE AMERICA >\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3522724.656.1.44f3dc07f3013ab64a00c7b3733a7af4 )

\*\*I WILL SACRIFICE $50 TO SAVE AMERICA >\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3522724.657.1.2874579df3defe1272ad294ba616e3e4 )

\*\*I WILL SACRIFICE $100 TO SAVE AMERICA >\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3522724.658.1.f732d78cf1cb872d668c2472baa0ca17 )

\*\*I WILL SACRIFICE $250 TO SAVE AMERICA >\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3522724.659.1.11b608ce96e2e6cb9b5f48e01a2bb884 )

\*\*I WILL SACRIFICE ANYTHING TO SAVE AMERICA >\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=3522724.660.1.50da62cfdb3395ad3d021fabf9367ffe )

I hope I can count on a stalwart and dedicated patriot like yourself to donate.

I wouldn't ask you if I wouldn't do the same thing in your shoes and if this race wasn't as important as it is. If we don't win in Arizona, we will lose America.

God Bless You,

Kari Lake

->

He’s handed the reins to Vice President Kamala Harris and [retreated to the beach](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=f83f24298d424ab9b4176be108514497&_e=EHyjeoLwiOrRbHjKD6PZwfKjT7-VeSoGIgCoGzNvigKADXR1DUAGtxNaLVqf5bJaaR5TsMgF7cDu0H0ZPKDzBWXzmbSidEud6CCwvT7zy0oiAsQ9PSm12pMc7ZVg7pkJML-6mqRqQD6nvUrN9zz98kEtG65LRxqxhN3L9euggDkTqGnbm2GHCnFk4V1ugeFL1BOkYWuDrX_uk1yg1JR3_xKpJjkvruk6GL3i39PQ4RTz66_nOUDpINM05TAietN03ILoDyLYK8qgpQktaIeTrZo5TUAroNuqV7n7niXld6KEnUiTHOoWjq2HsiIacAvwWW06z-xHHSk3ytE6CitWrA%3D%3D), utterly disconnected from the harsh realities that he’s put on everyday Americans. I won’t beat around the bush—Biden’s been out of the game for a long time, and he’s left Vice President Harris to puppeteer her far-left agenda unchecked. Her policies, straight out of the California playbook, promise skyrocketing taxes, spiraling homelessness, and an economy left in ruins. And it’s not just me saying this—[ _National Review_ editors](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=f83f24298d424ab9b4176be108514497&_e=EHyjeoLwiOrRbHjKD6PZwUVRD9ev4fVJmPvxpAtEoVNLDfNlgVk6G9FeTazE6h_M2i0-HnKd9DLZEPyxeUXpbx9mz9nu8CToyb0e53DF5KCMJSZzDUjWHNFgoS5VGRXBDIjam3a8YDpivWSdodetCPZvMZHeuOft4Oa2Clgz4KMbufcJI0Ue9lHI9U3UjG5V2p-wB5UU3bGw6zL8sQAHLgGCXVvNXe-OCNf0AOQtaSmPF2HB5VtXwpKDreBlEXgdfqVbW_oW3L1mWwOhbXoQdQ%3D%3D) are calling for Biden’s resignation, highlighting his complete failure to lead. Vance](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=f83f24298d424ab9b4176be108514497&_e=EHyjeoLwiOrRbHjKD6PZwYo8Dc21ESHakzor3L637NznCwYZb8Vm6HLgOaZJYRhhIPCQKYXHd5CWfbgcIePE454di4McjinTI-c3JeJ-p9bE4IdVnCS_e4JMa7fJnX26fWC_vXODM2wq11uszNmWL71wPfuGpZlCCLn3fzzGmtgkGVbMh0ZTk3CUbIUd9UUm6HjcW0OVDfEn2A5FHIU3RfPYCwYdvlxG0LjtQZFA2EvSwWXqV7HxAZrkcpmaX3ENprmAmDMQJXZbumQfo698VK4JobgAHQ_e-hzvxUVRGQg%3D) hit the nail on the head when he said, "If Joe Biden doesn't have the cognitive function to run for re-election, then he certainly doesn't have the cognitive function to remain as Commander-In-Chief.” The President’s neglect isn’t just careless—it’s a danger to our nation’s security and future. | | Staff Sgt. Ryan Knauss was a beacon of American valor and patriotism, embodying the highest ideals of service and sacrifice. His [loss in Kabul](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=f83f24298d424ab9b4176be108514497&_e=EHyjeoLwiOrRbHjKD6PZwe-Tn_w5qYe9yNZE_oUNVB58-Pm_lQqfr6nOmbWvAeAsw4RmF93CbgMoN1ZNJtYkziBNgrpE3kE08ELJw0GokqO8Mz76nrwD7oNWKSmfujVV50R6SGkhgGEBvr1JF9LnatLXn70oGqUNtnP0y39Q9H3wdNqLaesFf_bU12X98b_d8AL7ABcoIiftr_vPMHg9QkIXMKnZ0JKpzb8HVAJMKlgVHrThaADPh4-eku9tAzvymG3lc-wXVpKy0Augmy_JAdudrZzTQxHlrOIZv9CsHW7IaOQylVlwGjxeFNNrC6m7IJ307U6wZhwf7HeNV4aH-w%3D%3D) was a tragedy that should never have happened, and it’s a stark reminder of the grave mistakes made during the Afghanistan withdrawal. The hasty and [poorly executed decisions](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=f83f24298d424ab9b4176be108514497&_e=EHyjeoLwiOrRbHjKD6PZwYo8Dc21ESHakzor3L637NxvlwpIS_zbaKRtWrkLZZ9_t2kvWA4iiOOopN7YVLM-p_6uooR5-HG-CMWlet2HsD4643eXQXfzIdHng0YxEgdUwXAky0kfyPXbkDSm_MbsuH_Q9xsBvG1xhsmeCJatShTfRu0xrULYKnSft5rqjcIKWUBNHDdOSHEA1AEBnh-740HsG0_qY2nGcbQMKD1gVAzS0iTeGBaj-bdPr86ewuRbecIyps5U9G9mwWk-S3p8uu6UeHkYYQs0BEOPpSTg4vpedfizRjm_87TgpUaHBRUKVr96tBOZ9q_PO2XH_qTdzA%3D%3D) by the Biden administration left our troops vulnerable, leading to unnecessary loss of life. Staff Sgt. Knauss, who grew up in Corryton and joined the military right after graduating from Gibbs High School, exemplified true heroism. He voluntarily returned to Afghanistan after his deployment ended to help with the evacuation, risking his life to ensure others reached safety. His bravery and ultimate sacrifice [will never be forgotten by East Tennessee](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=f83f24298d424ab9b4176be108514497&_e=EHyjeoLwiOrRbHjKD6PZwf9rt6OMJA5UA8VNeDEjSpulQIqVcBFlBLoAP0OyZZeT_spaAS859VhWN24JiV3VlNDh-WUqbKcxHCaTJVtsSIqNuZ1UPZtG-SDnm6mi0LtGCf6Z__Pst5lZ04UTo57IwFeSx7KUfC_sWvniuFWtU5qh4U9B20WqYCEOgnoRxLuTk-bOi-wtRLrdW71eOPSFBRdJfhkyzKxhePcEVopeP4gWy8enxbo4nNYeWNsBZOAynAYA1HE3_mKKM9b-q1DzuNyaJqAZTRAPgj9tx6v5MYGSh3TPpfyTqGX9iyfftIXPWa5wNmv_3gEPFiFRsdqogQ%3D%3D), where his memory lives on in the hearts of all who knew him. His family will never walk alone, and we owe it to him to learn from these mistakes and protect the values he fought so valiantly for. Let us never forget the high cost of freedom and the responsibility we bear to honor those who defend it.

But Republicans are fired up too, and that comes with volunteers, attention, and, yes, money. It’s critical that we match, or even exceed their enthusiasm. Those donations are a demonstration of true grassroots strength, and they send a strong message to people about our campaign to those looking to support us. They send a message to people who want to spend against us that we have the strength to beat them. And by the time you read this, lots and lots of people have chipped in their $3. And now they're hoping you'll do the same. Because it all adds up. We’ve witnessed a whirlwind of historic events in the past month, so let’s recap
#

Hey friend,
To state the obvious, we’ve witnessed a whirlwind of historic events in the past month. Let’s recap:
**FIRST:** Last month, President Joe Biden announced that he was no longer seeking reelection, and Vice President Kamala Harris stepped up to become our new Democratic presidential nominee.
**THEN:** Just a couple of weeks into her campaign, Vice President Harris announced Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate.
**NOW:** Our gun safety movement depends on making sure that Kamala Harris and Tim Walz win this November. Both Vice President Harris and Governor Walz have proven track records when it comes to prioritizing gun safety. They are both ready to serve and will be the steadfast partners we need to keep making progress in our movement.
We need to build up A LOT of resources to fuel our get out the vote efforts and make sure that voters across the country know that the Harris-Walz ticket is the right choice to make our country safer.
That’s where you come in, team.
[**Please, will you make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us elect Vice President Harris and Tim Walz? Peter, Our job, as the NDRC’s Finance Team, is to help the organization plan budgets, set fundraising goals, and determine if we have the funding we need to accomplish what we’ve set out to do. When we build budgets with our leadership team and decide what type of programming we can afford, we use projections based on what we have seen previously. Typically, our organization sees a spike in donations around the end of the month — so we build that into our financial projections. That means our budgets are _planning_ on a certain amount of funding to come in around the end of this month. If we don’t hit this end-of-month goal, we miss our financial targets. **We just took a look at where we are. If we miss our financial targets, that could mean we have to schedule a meeting with NDRC leadership to make difficult choices about our budget.
We’re doing everything we can to make sure we can fund the work you’ve set out to do. We’re so grateful for your partnership in getting this all done. But being just about nine weeks from Election Day, there’s not enough time to make up for any missed goals.

Her MAGA opponent wants to be another destructive force in the Senate as Republicans aim to crush affordable health care, ban abortion, and do nothing about the senseless gun violence Nevadans know all too well.
