| | I am the son of Korean immigrants — born and raised in America, the product of New Jersey public schools, public servant, husband, and proud dad to two little troublemaking little boys. This community means everything to me and my family; it’s why I’m fighting to represent it in the U.S. Senate. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91822605/495104245/-1197072038?refcode=2024-08-30-eom5&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=5824ce31-d866-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODI0Y2UzMS1kODY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I4oIeH-WrzmACAOyHqBmdAaNmIisVSOXOI8ht9NT0x0=) When my parents came to America 50 years ago, they didn't know a single person in this entire country. They came here because they wanted to seek a better life for themselves and for their family. My father suffered as a baby from Polio, and both of my parents struggled with hunger and disease during childhood. My father went on to study in America and became a PhD scientist who dedicated his life to finding a cure for cancer and Alzheimer's. My mother became a nurse and helped serve thousands of people in New Jersey hospitals. My parents chose to raise me and my sister in New Jersey because they believed the top-notch public school system would give us the best opportunities to succeed. I did all of K-12 right here, and that education helped me become a Rhodes Scholar and a leading national security expert – working at the Pentagon and in Afghanistan as a civilian advisor to the military. New Jersey gave my family the opportunity to achieve the American dream, but now, the chaos, dysfunction, and extremism in our politics make me worry those same opportunities won't be there for my kids. body:
To see Trump use Section 60 of Arlington National Cemetery for his own political gain — for his staff to verbally and physically abuse the official trying to protect the sanctity of that hallowed ground — is something I never anticipated.
#
This week has not been easy.
For years, I’ve cringed every time I hear the reporting about Trump calling members of our military "suckers" and those who died in battle "losers."
But to see Trump use Section 60 of Arlington National Cemetery for his own political gain — for his staff to verbally and physically abuse the official trying to protect the sanctity of that hallowed ground — is something I never anticipated.
**My name is Karen Meredith, I am a Gold Star mother, and my son is buried in Section 60.**
My only child, 1LT Ken Ballard, joined the Army after graduating high school in 1995. As an Army granddaughter, Army daughter, Army sister, and Army mom, I couldn't be more proud of his decision.
My son deployed to Iraq in May of 2003, and 384 days later he was killed while fighting an Iranian-backed militia in Najaf. He had been scheduled to return home eight days earlier, but his tour was extended.
Ken, like others in our family, were not "suckers" for making the decision to serve their country. He was not a "loser" either.
Ken, and those who put on the uniform, are the best this country has to offer. But to Trump, they’re nothing more than props for his campaign.
Sometimes it's hard to know how to respond in these moments. For me, I have been active in the Gold Star and Veteran's communities as an advocate for Military families. I feel as if my work resisting Trump is an extension of that work.
And I am thankful to have a mechanism to do that through VoteVets.
I know that in 2024 — just like 2020 — VoteVets will have a critical role to play in keeping Trump out of the White House. And anything I can do to help, I am in. So today, I am asking for your help in that cause:

There are just over seven weeks left before Texans start voting in the 2024 election!
Everything we do between now and Election Day will determine whether Lizzie can continue to provide Houstonians with the strong and thoughtful leadership they deserve. It will determine whether and how much we can support other Democrats on the ballot, like Vice President Kamala Harris and Congressman (hopefully soon Senator) Colin Allred. It will determine whether we can take back the House and keep the White House in Democratic control.

Black people across the country are demonstrating unprecedented support and excitement for Kamala Harris. But it’s critical that we translate all that enthusiasm into actual votes.

That’s where The Collective PAC comes in. Over the past few years, we’ve registered more than 200,000 voters and provided more than 100,000 rides to the polls. We’ve proven we can deliver for Black candidates — _and we have every intention of surpassing those numbers this election season._

# A Public Conversation on Trafficking in America, Rank Choice Voting, and Election

We cordially invite you to an important event focused on safeguarding our freedoms and upholding the fundamental values of our nation: “Public Discussion on Human Trafficking, Ranked Choice Voting, and Electoral Integrity.”
**Event Details:****When** : Wednesday, September 18 **Time** : 7:00 PM (Doors open at 6:00 PM, and a cash bar will be available)**Where** : VFW Post 399, 465 Riverside Avenue, Westport, CT (lower level - rear entrance)
**Speakers Include:** Lt Gen Rod Bishop (USAF, Ret), Chairman of STARRS.usDiscussing Marxism in government.
Joe Oltmann, Conservative Daily in DenverReporting on human trafficking, just back from a fact-finding trip to Guatemala.
CT State Senator Rob SampsonAddressing the implications and importance of rank-choice voting.
Linda Szykowicz, Fight Voter Fraud Focusing on clean elections and voter rolls in Connecticut.This is a rare opportunity to hear from esteemed leaders and experts on topics critical to our nation’s future.
The event will provide insights into the pressing issues of human trafficking, the integrity of our elections, and the influence of Marxism within our government.
**Get Your Tickets:** General Admission - $30 (https://connecticutcentinal.com/vfw/)Premier Admission - $100 ](https://connecticutcentinal.com/vfw/)Livestream - $25 (https://connecticutcentinal.com/vfw/)
_A percentage of the proceeds will be donated to VFW Post 399 to_ _support their infrastructure development efforts._
**This event is more than just a discussion—it's a call to action for those who believe in the enduring power of freedom and the Constitution.**
We hope to see you there as we explore these critical issues together.

Straight from CNN, Team:
" Republican-backed legislation headed to Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp’s desk would establish new rules for challenging voters’ eligibility and make it easier to qualify for the presidential ballot – changes that could have consequences in this fall’s elections in a closely watched battleground state. "
A brief history before we get to why this change is important -- after the 2020 election triggered widespread false claims of voter fraud in Georgia, voter fraud organizations based in other states have driven deluded individuals in Georgia to lodge tens of thousands of voter eligibility challenges .
The 2021 Georgia voter suppression law made it so a single voter could bring an unlimited number of challenges, and election officials in some large counties have been inundated with demands to remove voters from the rolls. The vast majority of these challenges were eventually thrown out, but the effect on voter turnout was chilling .
So of course now opponents of voting rights were so thrilled with that result that they included a separate provision in this new 2024 bill that makes it easier to uphold challenges to voter registrations, with a clear goal to reduce turnout by picking and choosing whose votes get to count. And now the Governor has signed it into law.

Hi Friend -
I’m writing to you today with both an update and a request.
#### First, the Update
Over these last few months, True the Vote has been firing on all cylinders:
* **IV3** \- Assisted volunteers in 1623 counties across the country to submit ineligible voter records to their county elections office. This effort, called IV3 ([IV3.us](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.ZOvxkEhKDw9DETb6Ummm9zQuo-zt7v1AcpXkOLMbvNt6YrZM562R3uGahNjwIn7jkGt_IWnw-uSgtquK_mdpjjdISa-tLImUGCjFLnGJ8wiktZdWfYGLXaK7-THnHHXBY34twpBvEOw7ZS8lTpxyzD-ECb0Is0JqwIdFL9kEbFzyw6dAb6gdL6OzU0_PaAoCt6tMc6x_2V5_Y9Is5rsB4ygmYDSEVK_BpO1nu0va-wYvwmBsIS5lMyPgiHueupwG/49c/5EftOVuDRey2reMatJT1QA/h2/h001.CpJqkarG7HW5x7R9zOsWk8Fn0AGV3LUBIXdWDd4iN2k)) was an enormous success, resulting in over **1,000,000** records being evaluated. Our next step is to monitor these ineligible records to determine whether they request an absentee ballot or cast an early vote. This information will be useful in a variety of ways, not the least of which is litigation support.
* **Lawfare** \- Submitted our response to the 11th Circuit Court of Appeals in the Fair Fight vs. True the Vote lawsuit. (We won in Georgia federal court, then Fair Fight appealed to the 11th circuit and we necessarily filed a response brief.)The lawsuit concerned voters’ rights to petition government over ineligible voter registration records - and **our win in federal court was an awesome victory, in Georgia and across the country.** This is just one of several cases we are involved in.
* **Scan. Check. Protect**. - So far, we’ve assisted over 30,000 Americans with[ Scan. Check. Protect.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.QpSyXf61MHmBXCNRmciJjxjF7Oe08aKnD279kG6mSTk-n5bRfcZ4cHTURZHT7TNDqVd6F-n4FB4r9z_J3CJ3H3wH_HN79MRUtDrIfaAgy4-yx-agxfdSIeYQn7jY6YRUD1r3WpMh9mN8H-w-qx6NqvLPAIKe_U8dBsZOWLdhkWqKaXbdclFfB3VthT0YbKksGIcZaBh66ZQMoaXlEV5C6aS7B8gDnUfDBkU3opu57M8MqHZYaBPfCm0POmG6kaR_9Hs1ADtDEJUa4DswbwyA7B_vujBCOg1VKStO_JbEHN8/49c/5EftOVuDRey2reMatJT1QA/h3/h001.q4R0Gm0utpA8QN8fwVOqvRJ1y5Urb9srgsDKbfLIako), our online program for voter registration, voter record review, record cancellation, and mail-in ballot tracking.
* **“We Will Not Be Silenced”** \- We debuted this documentary on [Open.ink](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.flIQTCCIxNEqWg_ApxSzTldJLWARe02QMeZiVzZ-4kkgxD0ZvqePoP72EmpFS1WPEnni6Ci_yVKO67a3_y-2e1uAzLSLkLFiz2OGx6_RBhWwVscgD5YzO1CStAjogod3ZoK1CzgLZP89ndG47kCFsc2V8JHNVxDf3SNC_gWwdTVUhD1XmnQslT0tK9KyaBLdxWzjggdaHaKoeywlndx1EC8UeKs7ME-uYfuzkl72v2PDVIo-OrNca8gXgBCBv_QfvPE2e7IDkhwtK4yWV3IsF61zHW1PCKj8FnyCg0HgSDQ_gGViZqPQUdWWWUpfUjQg/49c/5EftOVuDRey2reMatJT1QA/h4/h001.AVOb4dL0ILvVlcZMMraV4CqvsDEIHGv9zQCCehH7E-Q). It is a compilation of harrowing testimonials from Democrats who experienced how Barack Obama appeared to have stolen the 2008 primary from the Hillary Clinton. Hey friend,
I’m fighting for a more free and prosperous nation for every American, but I’m counting on Democrats in Nevada and across the nation to join me in this fight for our future.
We need to hold the White House and the Senate if we want to deliver progress on the issues that matter most:
* Passing federal protections for abortion rights, birth control, and IVF
* Expanding access to quality, affordable health care
* Lowering costs for middle class families
* Taking action to reduce gun violence
* Demanding ethics and transparency for Supreme Court justices

There will be a stark choice for voters in this election between MAGA extremism and common sense leadership. If Republicans retake control of Washington, they will use their power to attack our democracy, roll back abortion rights even further, and hand out more tax breaks to billionaires and giant corporations. **_We will not go back._**
Nevada will likely determine control of the Senate this year. I stand with the women of America to protect our reproductive rights and bodily autonomy. So do Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Walz has spoken openly about how he and his wife conceived their two children through fertility treatments. This fight is also personal to him.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91834901/495134196/-1037916031?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-08-29_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0MDUxMGZjLWUzNjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Nb6wJtVCwhMYc4jSmAv6T0Uh7ll2UUs-FhWm71l0sT4=)

Peter,

Donald and J.D. Vance aren’t just the most anti-woman, anti-democratic GOP ticket in history — they’re plain weird.

While most Americans are worried about putting dinner on the table, Donald and Vance are busy complaining that “childless cat ladies” are the real problem facing America. And they’re not just going after people who don’t have kids — they’re trying to control our personal decisions about pregnancy and parenthood entirely.

In Donald and Vance’s America, families like mine would be under attack. I’m a “cat lady” who is lucky enough to have a human child thanks to fertility treatments. But because of my uncle’s work to pack our courts with extremist judges that led to the overturning of Roe v. Wade and abortion bans across the country, right-wing activists and lawmakers are now looking to restrict access to IVF and other fertility treatments next.

_**These are scary times, but it’s good to know where everyone stands.**_

I stand with the women of America to protect our reproductive rights and bodily autonomy. So do Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Walz has spoken openly about how he and his wife conceived their two children through fertility treatments. This fight is also personal to him.

**We know where Donald and Vance stand. And we need to make sure neither of them gets anywhere near the Oval Office.** [_**Pitch in a split donation between Democracy Defense Fund and Fight for Progress so that we can elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, flip the House, and defend the Senate!**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91834902/495134197/-1037916031?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-08-29_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0MDUxMGZjLWUzNjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Nb6wJtVCwhMYc4jSmAv6T0Uh7ll2UUs-FhWm71l0sT4=)

Last year, after Ohio voters overwhelmingly approved a constitutional amendment to protect reproductive rights, Vance called the people’s decision a “gut punch.”

We have the numbers. We can turn out millions of voters across the country who are ready to fight for our right to make our own decisions about our bodies and our families. So, this Election Day, let’s give Vance and Donald a gut punch they’ll remember.

In solidarity,
Dr. Mary L. Trump (and my cats Linden and Cap)

body:
But nothing prepares you to see a former President of the United States attack your husband on stage at a rally in front of thousands of his most devoted supporters.
#

Hey Peter, it’s Ruben’s wife, Sydney.
When Ruben and I were first talking about whether he’d run for Senate, I had a pretty good idea of what to expect.
I knew it’d be tough. I knew he’d have to spend a lot of time away from home, out on the campaign trail. I knew that it would mean a lot of attention directed at Ruben, at our family. And I knew that eventually the attack ads would start.
But nothing prepares you to see a former President of the United States attack your husband on stage at a rally in front of thousands of his most devoted supporters.
That’s not easy to watch.

name: Senators Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown
subject: a seven-fingered dirt farmer and a “disheveled” guy in a wrinkled suit
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Hi Derek,
Senators Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here!
It’s crystal clear: Montana and Ohio are on the top of Mitch’s Most Wanted list. And that’s not an exaggeration – McConnell aligned super PACs made their biggest ad buy EVER in Ohio and are dropping a whopping $65 million into Montana.
**[Political experts rank our elections as the most important Senate races on the map. But polls are tied in Montana and Ohio — and we need your help like never before to fight back and win. Will you donate $10 to split between our Big Sky Buckeye Fund and John Fetterman today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240830?refcode=em20240830-9334&refcode2=9334_434096_DPum81&akid=9334%2E434096%2EDPum81)**
You might be asking yourself, what’s Mitch McConnell got against a seven-fingered dirt farmer and a “disheveled” guy in a wrinkled suit?
Well, it’s pretty simple: We’ll work with _anyone_ to get the job done for our constituents and we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But that doesn’t make you very popular with the outside interest groups or the Majority Leader so they’re dropping millions of dollars to smear our names and lie about our records. **And right now, our campaigns are being OUTSPENT on TV ads by McConnell and his allies.**
**[We hate asking but it’s urgent: Can you chip in $10 – or anything you can afford – to split between Big Sky Buckeye Fund and John Fetterman to keep our own ads on the air? We can’t write ourselves million-dollar checks – we count on the support of this team to power our campaigns. It’s never been more important, friend.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240830?refcode=em20240830-9334&refcode2=9334_434096_DPum81&akid=9334%2E434096%2EDPum81)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240830?amount=5&refcode=em20240830-9334&refcode2=9334_434096_DPum81&akid=9334%2E434096%2EDPum81)**
The odds may seem overwhelming but we’ve both been underestimated before. With the power of this grassroots team, we can take on the outside spending and win this race.
We’re running out of time, friend. Together, let’s see it through.
Thanks for having our backs,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240830-9334-footer&t=1&refcode2=9334_434096_DPum81&akid=9334%2E434096%2EDPum81)**

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cybersecurity academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my end-of-month goal would be sending a crystal-clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.** **[_So please, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. tomorrow to help me continue our fight for progress this year? name: Scott Jensen
subject: Lawsuit Update - Ellison, Medical Board
body:
Important reminder | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/drscottjensen/lawsuit-update-8?e=9828080a05)
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

I have sued Keith Ellison and the Minnesota Board of Medical Practice for depriving me of my free speech rights and not complying with data requests. I am so thankful for the [support](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=a9ef8e5845&e=9828080a05) we've received through our [GiveSendGo campaign](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=319b8de93c&e=9828080a05).

This has been a long battle in multiple court rooms and I wanted to provide you with an update. We will NOT rest until doctors and other professionals have the freedom of dissenting, political opinion. I have [two critical updates](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=9035b0d0de&e=9828080a05) about these lawsuits, which can be found in [this video](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=f15f34561a&e=9828080a05) and [this video](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=4948ec3aa8&e=9828080a05). Both messages are also listed below and I'd appreciate you [getting up to speed](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=4b2d6058c4&e=9828080a05) in this battle of free speech:
---
| [ ](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=1bb23390fa&e=9828080a05 "Lawsuit Update Against Medical Board and Keith Ellison")
---
| [ ](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=1437333222&e=9828080a05 "ANOTHER Lawsuit Update")
---
| We will not relent! Thank you for [your support](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=8526681c4e&e=9828080a05) in this fight for free speech, for your prayers and [contributions](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=119b66fd45&e=9828080a05). This is one small effort in a grander initiative to take back the freedoms we've long taken for granted.

God bless you this Labor Day Weekend. Enjoy time with friends and family, and be heartened for the fight ahead.

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

name: Dr. Kristin Hook
subject: August in Review
body:
| | | | | [](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=50172a2572&e=395a33a3d2)
---
|
# Less than 70 Days Until Election Day!
---
| It’s been a VERY busy past few weeks, and I wanted to share with youall of the ground we’ve been covering here on the campaign trail!
Even though it’s been hot out, we’ve been pounding the pavement, connecting with voters at their doorstep, learning what matters most to them this election cycleand a little bit about their sense of humor....
---
| I have loved getting to meet and know so many amazing people all across our district, andI am super grateful for all of the fantastic volunteerswho have shown up to help out!
In addition to 7 block walks and 5 meet & greets,on August 3rd, I got to speak and serve on a panel at the first ever Mini-Dem Convention for TX-21, wherefolks across the _BEST TEN TEXAS COUNTIES_ came together in Fredericksburg to meet their candidates, learn about flipping seats from red to blue, andshare in the excitement for our new presidential nominee!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **THE LEAD LIVE!**_August 12th_
I made the case for why Chip Roy is bad for our district as a special guest on [The Lead Live!](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=83b749f44d&e=395a33a3d2), hosted by Louis Amestoy at the Pint & Plow in Kerrville!
---
| [](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=4ba0168a89&e=395a33a3d2)
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | **HIP HIP HOORAY!**_August 15th_
I officially earned an endorsement from the National Association of Letter Carriers (Alamo Branch No 421) – coming from three generations of postal workers, this endorsement is _very_ near and dear to my heart!
---
| As the school year has started back up,we have had to say goodbye to two INCREDIBLEassistants who grew up right here in our districtand worked hard all summer to help us Flip Chip before heading off to college!
**We’ll miss you SO MUCH, Olivia and Tez!**
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| And of course, how could I forget, I attended the Democratic Convention in Chicago, where I made important connections and got to see Kamala Harris accept the nomination for President – a memory that will last a lifetime!
---
| I left Chicago feeling SO inspired and ready to take on these next several weeksin our campaign and to continue building on the momentum! I'm running for Congress because there’s a lot we’ve got to do in order to save our country from extremists like my opponent and make real change for our working families.
[**If you’re able to, will you pitch in $25 or whatever makes sense**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=dd4c59132f&e=395a33a3d2)[**by our monthly fundraising deadline tomorrow?**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=c2ae8f76c9&e=395a33a3d2)
I’m going to keep fighting my heart out for this, but I need your help!
---
|

Folks—I’m stressed. My campaign team just called me to share that we're still $51,947 short of our August fundraising goal.
I’ll explain more in a moment, but first I have to ask: Will you make a split donation of any amount right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton to help us close the gap before our end-of-month deadline? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-tester]
Mitch McConnell is flooding in millions of dollars to smear my record and boost his handpicked candidate. Unfortunately, these attacks are working: The latest polls have this race wide open.
Look, I’ve never been your typical politician. I’m a farmer. I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I still farm the land my parents homesteaded 100 years ago. (Sharla and I are harvesting as we speak.)
I try every day to do right by the people of Montana. That means standing up to anybody—including Mitch McConnell and his special interests—to improve health care for veterans, lower prescription drug costs, and protect Medicare and Social Security.
But if I don’t get more grassroots support before the end of August, there’s a very real chance our team could miss our goal. Mitch McConnell and outside groups are spending nearly $90 million to buy this Senate seat—and the only thing that can stop them is you.
As much as I hate asking, I have to: Can I count on you to make a split donation of $10 between Seth Moulton and my campaign before our end-of-month goal? When we win in November, it’ll be because folks like you. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-tester]
Thank you for your support,
Jon

body:

---
| Peter- Last week, I went on HBO’s Real Time with Bill Maher to give my perspective on the upcoming presidential election between Donald Trump and Kamala Harris. I was on a panel with Bill Clinton’s former campaign manager James Carville, and we debated everything from illegal immigration to economic policy. There are clips included below, but the full interview is worth your time. **I do these interviews because it’s critically important for conservatives to speak to audiences who do not usually hear our message. We will never grow our movement if we only speak to our own side, which is why I always jump at opportunities to go on shows like Real Time, CNN, or any other mainstream outlet that leans left. If you agree that we must continue to engage with a combative press to push our conservative message, I would appreciate any donation you can make to my campaign. Your contributions help me win the messaging war against the left, which is ultimately how we will win the upcoming election and persuade more Americans to join our conservative movement. You can donate at the following link:**
---
| | | | | [ DONATE NOW ](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J6J1NHAP21TKV4DDEPY9F2B0_1)
---
| As always, thank you for your continued support. Now here’s your brief.
---
|
---
| WHICH PARTY HAS GOTTEN MORE EXTREME?
---
| |
---
| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01J6J1NHAP21TKV4DDEPY9F2B0_2)
---
| A constant refrain from Democrats is that it is the Republican party that has strayed from its original positions to more extreme policy stances. But is that actually true? I debunked that myth on Bill Maher’s show with a simple experiment. Which party platform do you think the below quotes came from on the issues of immigration and the role of government? On immigration: “We must remain a nation of laws. We cannot tolerate illegal immigration and we must stop it. For years, Washington talked tough but failed to act. Our borders might as well not have existed. Illegal immigration was rampant. Criminal immigrants, deported after committing crimes in America, returned the very next day to commit crimes again.” On the role of government: “This is what our party stands for - the end of the era of big government. We need a smaller, more effective, more efficient, less bureaucratic government that reflects our time-honored values. The American people do not want big government solutions and they do not want empty promises.They want a government that gives a moderate, achievable, common-sense agenda that will improve people's daily lives and not increase the size of government.” That is actually from Bill Clinton’s party platform in 1996. Dear Friend,
I wanted to bring to your attention the recent interview with Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz, where Harris was once again caught spreading lies. During the interview, Harris was asked about fracking and she outright lied!!

It's troubling to see our leaders blatantly disregarding the facts in such a critical area as energy policy. Fracking is a pivotal issue, and the American people deserve honesty from their elected officials. Instead, we're seeing a pattern of deception that undermines trust and transparency.
The truth is that fracking plays a major role in our energy independence, and it's vital to address these issues with integrity and clarity. Lying only serves to polarize and mislead the public, which is something we cannot afford.
I believe it's important to hold our leaders accountable and ensure that the truth is at the forefront of any public discourse.

body:
We Need You're Help | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us14.campaign-archive.com/?e=7b1b739a89&u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=0e27f9521d)

# “Brat Summer to Madam President"
---
|
Hey Everyone,
I know you're probably getting a lot of emails from my dad—trust me, I do too, and I’m just down the hall from him! Growing up, our home was always a hub for political events. My dad would host senators, governors, and even presidents. I still remember the time I shared my birthday party with Congressman Brad Sherman’s fundraiser; I’ve still got a comb from that day to prove it.
While I’ve always admired my dad’s ability to make a difference, I never really got involved in his political efforts—until I met Kamala. When she came and gave a speech at our home while running for California Attorney General, her passion and excitement inspired me to get involved. Since then, she has become like an auntie to me. In fact, we often joke that we have a guest room in our home dedicated just for her visits.
This past month, just a few days before she became the nominee, we hosted her at our home again. It was an incredibly inspiring experience, hearing her words and seeing firsthand what her campaign means to women, South Asians, immigrants, and so many Americans who just can’t take another four years of Trump’s chaos and divisiveness.
Kamala truly understands the challenges that women, especially those in my generation, face. As a South Asian, mixed-race woman, and the daughter of immigrants, her story has given me the courage to pursue my own dreams without hesitation. _(Sorry, Dad, I’m not running for president!) B_ ut as excited as I am about Kamala, I’m equally terrified at the thought of another four years under Trump’s leadership—with its endless lies, xenophobic policies, and lack of support for our generation in accessing education, securing good jobs, and owning homes. I fear that millions in my generation may never fully recover.
While I may not be as politically inclined as my brilliant father—you guys know he’s a full-time doctor saving lives, right?—I do believe in Kamala’s character, experience, and compassion. Most importantly, I believe it’s time for a woman to lead our nation. Kamala has the potential to be a great president, but she needs our support.
Please consider contributing to our grassroots fundraising efforts to ensure that Kamala’s "Brat Summer" turns into a victory this fall. [**Donate Now!**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=ebbf7b6908&e=7b1b739a89) Thank you for considering this request. And rest assured, if you donate, I’ll make sure my dad sends fewer emails—I promise!
Best,
Maaeda
P.S. If you’re not able to donate, please look for opportunities to volunteer your time with the local campaign, convince a neighbor to vote (especially in Nevada, Michigan and Pennsylvania), and be active on social media to get the truth out about Kamala and combat misinformation. It all adds up and makes a difference. clean_body: We Need You're Help | | | | | | | | | “Brat Summer to Madam President" | Hey Everyone, I know you're probably getting a lot of emails from my dad—trust me, I do too, and I’m just down the hall from him! Growing up, our home was always a hub for political events. My dad would host senators, governors, and even presidents. I still remember the time I shared my birthday party with Congressman Brad Sherman’s fundraiser; I’ve still got a comb from that day to prove it. While I’ve always admired my dad’s ability to make a difference, I never really got involved in his political efforts—until I met Kamala. When she came and gave a speech at our home while running for California Attorney General, her passion and excitement inspired me to get involved. Since then, she has become like an auntie to me. In fact, we often joke that we have a guest room in our home dedicated just for her visits. This past month, just a few days before she became the nominee, we hosted her at our home again. It was an incredibly inspiring experience, hearing her words and seeing firsthand what her campaign means to women, South Asians, immigrants, and so many Americans who just can’t take another four years of Trump’s chaos and divisiveness. Kamala truly understands the challenges that women, especially those in my generation, face. As a South Asian, mixed-race woman, and the daughter of immigrants, her story has given me the courage to pursue my own dreams without hesitation. (Sorry, Dad, I’m not running for president!) B ut as excited as I am about Kamala, I’m equally terrified at the thought of another four years under Trump’s leadership—with its endless lies, xenophobic policies, and lack of support for our generation in accessing education, securing good jobs, and owning homes. I fear that millions in my generation may never fully recover. While I may not be as politically inclined as my brilliant father—you guys know he’s a full-time doctor saving lives, right?—I do believe in Kamala’s character, experience, and compassion. Most importantly, I believe it’s time for a woman to lead our nation. Kamala has the potential to be a great president, but she needs our support. Please consider contributing to our grassroots fundraising efforts to ensure that Kamala’s "Brat Summer" turns into a victory this fall. Thank you for considering this request. And rest assured, if you donate, I’ll make sure my dad sends fewer emails—I promise! Best, Maaeda P.S. subject: I was attacked for being a black conservative
body:
Help students like me hear the truth... | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=c85df7afd6bc4e9ca13299d7ad4c96bf&_t=zaK6gr_-Rq6xFRl_cmtfJ_Xk139eIm1zLj29P-Q6iRqOTgLT3Hx5nMvdscBwPmZoDHsdrs39I5I-HFJLqPiB7yeHy7JYDdvmQhw8Nz0sNjgBQgfQFvgbId7OM7MbCMFh)_
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c85df7afd6bc4e9ca13299d7ad4c96bf&_e=a4ccJPxivxj_nKFojsesAM_nCLot5D6jCS41ymQkD6XDp60wAiljDK5W_N_AsHMICcM3cK_6qb49SJaj2mZVyy7AkZc9nFrM4JDYhsqZw3KSXTB0MaenjQLtBGglndP3DJczDXYLN0WXlvkIeR81KWcmDNwSAmCcvnxEKZwmrxsd3uy7UuwloavrXmuDjsA0o7ogj2ToUiOFJvfXf310-JF8JE2BFheOvbl9jUK1gqsIU7ylgKLnlC7q41BMmi_mKbnakqsCtXCZMzf8AfbiYbEppDSu13XTeJ7RgklEKcqKzva97ycdQQRbNb1QHewgdA_SBftE1fJJS1cnIsLTFX1TjHVvYEqJrIojjiQTHqEqVKzPZPVr-cq33HlL_S31)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c85df7afd6bc4e9ca13299d7ad4c96bf&_e=a4ccJPxivxj_nKFojsesAM_nCLot5D6jCS41ymQkD6XDp60wAiljDK5W_N_AsHMICcM3cK_6qb49SJaj2mZVyy7AkZc9nFrM4JDYhsqZw3KSXTB0MaenjQLtBGglndP3DJczDXYLN0WXlvkIeR81KWcmDNwSAmCcvnxEKZwmrxsd3uy7UuwloavrXmuDjsA0o7ogj2ToUiOFJvfXf310-B8xVD2Ff-Bml9viUk92xwPoSLef9Mbf7nkrwC4fLtyB7yV6pZsYdtDDFyImZM4JFXHQdxD5gvVDKrDcsAon7PHvlScieu4l2HLYsFfmL-3r8IzYvCwA2M4QIXz1hshQQ2aSB3AUCK9Rzi7yEvkTTKRCtevLdoI1Hj3L7EG430qt)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c85df7afd6bc4e9ca13299d7ad4c96bf&_e=a4ccJPxivxj_nKFojsesAM_nCLot5D6jCS41ymQkD6XDp60wAiljDK5W_N_AsHMICcM3cK_6qb49SJaj2mZVyy7AkZc9nFrM4JDYhsqZw3KSXTB0MaenjQLtBGglndP3DJczDXYLN0WXlvkIeR81KWcmDNwSAmCcvnxEKZwmrxsd3uy7UuwloavrXmuDjsA0o7ogj2ToUiOFJvfXf310-EtiVszuR9jdKxhG1BKd8P4CiIy3uqy8jm2lXA6P6S8fQ_P8F6zAVOWUYQLRsV2MT6HqluqPAIXaEGN0RqJJH7S4vo2EGxWildgW1RygB89JfSkHrsHONnLryWwvYKDfseZR82XREU4EtUKoEmc2S4LzQLzipCmI0--9dH65XA78) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c85df7afd6bc4e9ca13299d7ad4c96bf&_e=a4ccJPxivxj_nKFojsesAM_nCLot5D6jCS41ymQkD6XDp60wAiljDK5W_N_AsHMICcM3cK_6qb49SJaj2mZVyy7AkZc9nFrM4JDYhsqZw3KSXTB0MaenjQLtBGglndP3DJczDXYLN0WXlvkIeR81KWcmDNwSAmCcvnxEKZwmrxsd3uy7UuwloavrXmuDjsA0o7ogj2ToUiOFJvfXf310-OqEAZ4EMcLv8TF_KOhr2lE4rp-ndlNYF4zQjwbGQ7PnRSEBZ6Up2llCWC9kBTdQXbt-mDr7glipjSQR4lBhhDB6qbnfHs60GLRrhEXxdKRRVK8Ua2fL5Ja9P8ZNr90VxWR1DFcUXOzMDnAVan6gbdC0POhUPVZGo-mewyUU3LsM)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**
**Chairwoman, University of Iowa YAF**

| | | | Friends,

Today marks three years since the U.S. evacuation from Afghanistan. Since then, over 80,000 Afghan allies have been evacuated to the United States, yet nearly half of them remain in a legal limbo of humanitarian parole, with no pathway to citizenship. Congress can change this and uphold the promise we made to our Afghan allies by passing the bipartisan _**[Afghan Adjustment Act](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=6600751d8d&e=33f53a5b1a)**_ , led this year by the For Country Caucus Vice Chair Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks and with support from Democratic Co-Chair Jason Crow. The Afghan Adjustment Act would put Afghans who are already present in the United States on an expedited path towards permanent residency, and would require the State Department to prioritize expediting the visa process for those we left behind. We are working on its passage this year along with a provision in the State and Foreign Operations spending bill co-led by our Senate ally, Senator Roger Wicker, to extend the Afghan Special Immigrant Visa (SIV) program through 2027, and to authorize an additional 20,000 SIVs. We produced this short video with Rep. Zach Nunn and Rep. Seth Moulton in the For Country Caucus, as well as our colleagues, Mahnaz Akbari, Commander of the Afghan Female Tactical Platoon, and U.S. Army Veteran Rebekah Edmondson, who trained the Afghan Female Tactical Platoon.
---

You can read more about our ongoing efforts to support our Afghan allies **[HERE](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=8566e4807b&e=33f53a5b1a).**

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends, Today marks three years since the U.S. evacuation from Afghanistan. Since then, over 80,000 Afghan allies have been evacuated to the United States, yet nearly half of them remain in a legal limbo of humanitarian parole, with no pathway to citizenship. Congress can change this and uphold the promise we made to our Afghan allies by passing the bipartisan , led this year by the For Country Caucus Vice Chair Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks and with support from Democratic Co-Chair Jason Crow. The Afghan Adjustment Act would put Afghans who are already present in the United States on an expedited path towards permanent residency, and would require the State Department to prioritize expediting the visa process for those we left behind. We are working on its passage this year along with a provision in the State and Foreign Operations spending bill co-led by our Senate ally, Senator Roger Wicker, to extend the Afghan Special Immigrant Visa (SIV) program through 2027, and to authorize an additional 20,000 SIVs. We produced this short video with Rep. Zach Nunn and Rep. Seth Moulton in the For Country Caucus, as well as our colleagues, Mahnaz Akbari, Commander of the Afghan Female Tactical Platoon, and U.S. Army Veteran Rebekah Edmondson, who trained the Afghan Female Tactical Platoon. | | | Earlier this year, bipartisan veterans in the For Country Caucus helped secure an additional 12,000 SIVs; the largest single-time increase in visas since the program was established in 2009. Rep. Jason Crow, Rep. Brad Wenstrup, and others in the For Country Caucus helped lead this to passage. You can read more about our ongoing efforts to support our Afghan allies . | We hope you have a good Labor Day weekend. name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Is this really what ULTRA-MAGA calls Patriotism?
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Donald Trump, a man who dodged the draft and notoriously mocked veterans like John McCain, has now stooped to an appalling new low.
In a desperate attempt to save his failing campaign, he used Arlington National Cemetery—a sacred resting place for our nation’s fallen heroes—as the backdrop for an illegal campaign video.
Trump and his Ultra-MAGA cronies didn’t stop at desecrating this hallowed ground with their shameless political stunt.
When a dedicated cemetery employee stepped in to uphold the law and prevent this illegal filming, she was physically assaulted—on the very grounds where our brave soldiers rest.
Adding insult to injury, these bullies then smeared her character, calling her a “despicable individual” and “a disgrace.”
Is this really what they call patriotism?
If you're as outraged as I am by Trump's mockery of our veterans and Jim Jordan's failure to stand up for those who served, now is the time to act. Your contribution will help us expose their lies and deliver real support to those who’ve sacrificed for our country. Contribute today, and let's show them that we’re not backing down. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240830_arlington_link1]
Trump’s treatment of veterans has always been abysmal.
From the time he dismissed soldiers who died in battle as “suckers and losers” to blocking critical veterans’ legislation, his actions speak louder than his empty words and stunts.
It’s all part of the ULTRA-MAGA playbook—pretend to be hyper-patriotic while mocking and abandoning the very people who served this country.
And make no mistake, Jim Jordan is right there with him, voting against bills like the PACT Act, which expanded healthcare for veterans exposed to toxic burn pits and other environmental disasters during their service.
Jim Jordan is more interested in getting on FOX and chasing conspiracies than standing up for those who’ve stood on the front lines for u s.
Our veterans deserve better.
As the granddaughter of a WW-II Veteran, former military spouse, and your next Congresswoman, you can be certain that I will ALWAYS honor and support those who serve our nation in uniform.
I will never use our veterans or their families as props for cheap, scammy campaign stunts.
I will work tirelessly to ensure they receive the benefits, care, and respect they’ve earned.
My vision for helping veterans is rooted in concrete policies, not lip service.
I will work to ensure they have access to quality healthcare, mental health support, and job opportunities when they return home.
I will stand up for them every single day, just as they stood up for us.
Contribute today to help us send Jim Jordan and the rest of these MAGA phonies packing. Our veterans deserve leaders who will fight for them, not use them as political pawns. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240830_arlington_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

name: Jena Griswold
subject: Breaking the glass ceiling
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jena for Colorado
body:
https://jenaforcolorado.com/ [https://jenaforcolorado.com/]
Peter –
Six years ago, when I first ran for office, it seemed like an impossible task. At the age of 32, I was running for a seat a Democrat hadn’t won in 60 years—facing a popular incumbent. I had never run for office before, and folks like me don’t tend to run and win statewide office.
Growing up in rural Colorado, my family experienced tough times. We were on and off food stamps and in and out of food banks. I started working the summer after 7th grade, and was the first person in my family to attend a four-year college and then law school.
Despite some long odds, I became Colorado’s first elected Democratic Secretary of State since Eisenhower was President, one of the few women ever elected to statewide executive office, and the youngest Secretary of State in the nation. I have the privilege of working for the people of Colorado and ensuring that every eligible voter is able to participate in our democracy and that our elections continue to set the gold standard for the nation.
But my journey is not just my own. It’s part of a broader movement of women who are stepping up to lead, challenging the status quo, and redefining what’s possible for our nation. This year, as we see Kamala Harris as the Democratic nominee for President, we are reminded of how far we’ve come—and how much further we can go.
Kamala’s nomination isn’t just a milestone; it’s a testament to the power of perseverance and the impact of representation. It shows young girls across the country that their voices matter and that their leadership is not just welcomed but essential.
Women have always been at the forefront of change, whether in our communities, our states, or our nation. We bring unique perspectives and solutions that enrich our democracy. And now, with Kamala at the helm, we have the opportunity to continue this momentum, to break even more barriers, and to ensure that our government truly reflects the diverse voices of America.
As I reflect on my own journey, I am inspired by the progress we’ve made and the possibilities ahead. Together, we can build a future where leadership knows no bounds, where every voice is heard, and where our democracy works for everyone.
Thank you for being a part of this journey
– Jena Griswold

Organized labor is one of the greatest collective achievements our country has ever made.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91849073/495170883/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMTNjYTZkNi1mNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G682rY0b0mSfMB-qV8DM7iknxFwM8K9OQzc1LTJT8Mg=&emci=b1dd5591-8361-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=c13ca6d6-f466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=9494239)

| | I was raised in a union household. As the son of a union power line worker and a mom who managed the books while raising eight kids, I learned early in life the value of a dollar and the importance of hard work — and how unions helped families like mine thrive. **I know firsthand that a good-paying, union job is the key to growing the middle class. So, ahead of the Labor Day weekend, I wanted to share what unions mean to me and our community.** We are facing a crisis across America, where some of our hardest workers struggle each day to feed their families and afford the basics. I believe that unions are the first and best support system for America's working class. [**I am running for re-election so I can continue to fight for working-class people here in Northwest Washington. Contribute $17 now to join my fight.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91849074/495170884/1596212816?refcode=2024-08-30-labor&recurring=&amount=17&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=c13ca6d6-f466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMTNjYTZkNi1mNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G682rY0b0mSfMB-qV8DM7iknxFwM8K9OQzc1LTJT8Mg=) [Donate Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91849075/495170885/1596212816?refcode=2024-08-30-labor&recurring=&amount=17&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=c13ca6d6-f466-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMTNjYTZkNi1mNDY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G682rY0b0mSfMB-qV8DM7iknxFwM8K9OQzc1LTJT8Mg=) Unions represent the good that comes from us banding together to demand more of each other. For generations, workers have forged better lives through higher wages, improved benefits, and stronger protections thanks to their ability to collectively take a stand. And, as we struggle through a particularly divisive time in our country's history, I cannot think of a moment in my lifetime when union values have been more needed: a sense of togetherness and a commitment to hard work. **That is why I am proud to have the support of****a dozen****unions and union leaders in our grassroots campaign to restore the economic dignity of the working class:**

name: Brianna
subject: Fair maps 🤝 fair elections
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
Goal: $5,000 to help in these crucial weeks before the election.
|
---

First, the good news on voter participation, Peter:
* **In Wisconsin’s primary earlier this month** — the first election after new fair maps were enacted — the highest number of voters in 60 years turned out for a presidential year partisan primary. One draw? New competitive districts. This follows what we’ve seen again and again: Fair maps motivate more people to get involved in elections!

Now, the bad news:
* In**Arizona,** a ballot initiative would essentially stop term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges — and the ballot initiative would be retroactive. If it passes, it would overturn the results of any election this November that unseats a current state supreme court justice. This includes two GOP judges who ruled to uphold the state’s Civil War-era abortion ban, who voters are trying to get out of office. **This would take power away from voters after they cast their ballots — and it’s a tremendous, partisan abuse of power.**
* In**Louisiana** , newly fair maps are in place (and will stay in place!) for November — but afterwards, Black voters could lose an opportunity district if the current district lines are overturned. Black Louisianians make up about one-third of the state’s population, but would only have the opportunity to elect the candidate of their choice in just one of the state’s six congressional districts if the current congressional map is overturned.**This is another attempt to water down the power of voters.**
* In **Georgia,** the election certification processes keep changing, and the election board plans to meet next month to consider even more rule changes. This is confusing for poll workers and election officials, and these last-minute changes could lead to issues on November 5 when it’s time to count votes. **These are partisan games that could have monumental consequences for the state’s election.**

[**These states are clear examples of why we need fair maps and fair elections. And at All On The Line, we’re committed to both.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91849665/495172332/1243206785?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_AugEOM_email_20240830-AOTL-RedLiteND-AugEOM-Brianna_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240830-AOTL-RedLiteND-AugEOM-Brianna_&utm_campaign=AugEOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdkMzBhOWQwLWY0NjYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Rr2XqNvRKd-yeWHmM94A2reMkatmELeQ660jrKg3_NU=)
Bad actors keep trying to tilt the scales in their favor by silencing voters’ voices — from restricting voting rights to manipulating maps. But we’re working to turn out voters across the country, recruit poll workers to ensure everyone is able to cast their ballot in a fair and timely manner, and make sure the will of the people is not only heard, but respected and reflected.

clean_body: Goal: $5,000 to help in these crucial weeks before the election. | First, the good news on voter participation, Peter: In Wisconsin’s primary earlier this month — the first election after new fair maps were enacted — the highest number of voters in 60 years turned out for a presidential year partisan primary. One draw? New competitive districts. This follows what we’ve seen again and again: Fair maps motivate more people to get involved in elections! Now, the bad news: InArizona, a ballot initiative would essentially stop term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges — and the ballot initiative would be retroactive. If it passes, it would overturn the results of any election this November that unseats a current state supreme court justice. This includes two GOP judges who ruled to uphold the state’s Civil War-era abortion ban, who voters are trying to get out of office. This would take power away from voters after they cast their ballots — and it’s a tremendous, partisan abuse of power. InLouisiana , newly fair maps are in place (and will stay in place!) for November — but afterwards, Black voters could lose an opportunity district if the current district lines are overturned. Black Louisianians make up about one-third of the state’s population, but would only have the opportunity to elect the candidate of their choice in just one of the state’s six congressional districts if the current congressional map is overturned.This is another attempt to water down the power of voters. In Georgia, the election certification processes keep changing, and the election board plans to meet next month to consider even more rule changes. This is confusing for poll workers and election officials, and these last-minute changes could lead to issues on November 5 when it’s time to count votes. These are partisan games that could have monumental consequences for the state’s election. = Bad actors keep trying to tilt the scales in their favor by silencing voters’ voices — from restricting voting rights to manipulating maps. But we’re working to turn out voters across the country, recruit poll workers to ensure everyone is able to cast their ballot in a fair and timely manner, and make sure the will of the people is not only heard, but respected and reflected. you chip in to help reach our $5,000 goal, you will help our work to strengthen our democracy and let every American have an equal voice in our government. Peter, I may sound like a broken record when I tell you that I’m different from most politicians, but I really mean it.

When it comes to poverty or inequality, food insecurity or housing, mental health or LGBTQ+ rights, I don’t _just_ think about policy — I think about my own experiences. **For me, Peter, policy _is_ personal. It always has been.**

I am a Black, Afro-Latino, LGBTQ+ American. I’m a product of public housing. I don't come from a political family. I am open about my own experiences with depression. I don't have fancy degrees.

**What I _do_ have is lived experience, and I am lucky to bring my viewpoint to Congress, where my unique perspective motivates much of what I do.**

Peter, I vow to never give up on these fights so that more folks like me can have a seat at the table — _but I can’t do this alone._

[Can you chip in $3 to help fuel my campaign in our election year? Hi there!
We have a busy day today so I brewed a big pot of coffee to keep myself and the team going. ☕
Here’s what we have ahead of us: tomorrow is our final end-of-month fundraising deadline before the primary election on September 10th, and we still haven’t quite hit our goal. So I’m reaching out to ask if you can help put us over the top!
**Here’s a personalized link you can use to pitch in now:_[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240830-1?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240830-1?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20240830-1103-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=1103_21716_oB9PF6&akid=1103%2E21716%2EoB9PF6)_**
I’m not taking anyone’s vote for granted. I’m putting in the work to hear from as many neighbors as possible up and down Delaware. And the more money we raise from emails like these, the less time I have to spend worrying about fundraising!
[**So click here or use the link above to pitch in $5 or whatever you can before tomorrow’s deadline.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240830-1?refcode=em20240830-1-1103&amount=5&refcode2=1103_21716_oB9PF6&akid=1103%2E21716%2EoB9PF6)
Thank you so much for your support. I can’t do this without you!
Sarah McBride

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91853060/495182556/1561815853?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzM1NjM4Yy1mOTY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9kRh7gDum_EB7BcZSLCrbUUhpu-5VaDSl__PDcQhob4=&emci=d0d86fdb-b463-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=7335638c-f966-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=12666102) Hey Peter – it’s Mary Alice Blackstock, Yadira Caraveo’s campaign manager, with our strategy for the rest of the election. Do you pay rent, team?
The person writing this email (Hey! 👋) does. So do a lot of us here at Youth Vote HQ. We’re spread out across the country, but we’re all in agreement on one thing: Rent is _entirely_ too high.
And it’s not just us! Harvard’s Joint Center for Housing Studies found that **50% of renters nationwide can’t afford housing.**
31% of Gen Z adults are living with their parents _because they just can’t afford rent._ And it’s not because we don’t have jobs; wages are too low, student loans are too high, and the price of housing just keeps going up.
[We’re in the middle of a housing crisis. And it won’t end if we don’t step up and do something about it. Friends -- this campaign to register 1 million new voters as a coalition is the most important thing we're doing over the next 108 days.
Vote-suppressing state legislatures are gearing up to pass more restrictive laws. Congress is paralyzed. Beating our voter registration goal -- again -- to register so many new voters might be our best hope to turn the tide so we can protect and expand our right to vote.
The math is simple -- every $3 can help register a new voter. Beating our goal is going to take every single one of us. Can we count on you to chip in $36 and help register 12 new voters, Team? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=083024_2&amount=36]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=083024_2&amount=25]
CNN: Michelle Obama makes voter registration push [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=083024_2&amount=36]
Team -- In 2022 Former First Lady Michelle Obama challenged a coalition of voting rights organizations to be a part of her efforts to "register more than a million new voters across the country" as part of that year's elections . We're ramping up to do it again this year and we're asking for your help so we can do our part to reach that goal.
The math is simple:
➜ It costs us around $3 to register a new voter
➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we can register 10,000 new voters
➜ Polls show a major shift going on, and Michelle's work can truly impact 2024's elections
Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful .
Will you chip in $36 or more today to help register 12 new voters? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=083024_2&amount=36]
GIVE $36 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=083024_2&amount=36]
Michelle Obama knows the score. She's compared modern voter suppression tactics to “poll taxes, literacy tests, and laws designed to strip away [our] power,” and said that “we must give Congress no choice but to act decisively to protect the right to vote and make the ballot box more accessible for everyone.”
This is when we need to pull out all the stops. There's so much on the line in 2024, with just months to go before Election Day. Registering more than 1 million new voters this year could make the difference between opponents of voting rights taking charge to codify voter suppression for the next decade or having the votes we need to end the filibuster and pass sweeping new voting rights laws.
Team: Your $36 goes directly to forging a more inclusive democracy by registering 12 new voters and making sure every single vote counts. Vote-suppressing state legislatures are gearing up to pass more restrictive laws. Congress is paralyzed. Beating our voter registration goal -- again -- to register so many new voters might be our best hope to turn the tide so we can protect and expand our right to vote. The math is simple -- every $3 can help register a new voter. Beating our goal is going to take every single one of us. Can we count on you to chip in $36 and help register 12 new voters, Team? >> [] Voter Action Project Logo [] CNN: Michelle Obama makes voter registration push [] Team -- In 2022 Former First Lady Michelle Obama challenged a coalition of voting rights organizations to be a part of her efforts to "register more than a million new voters across the country" as part of that year's elections . We're ramping up to do it again this year and we're asking for your help so we can do our part to reach that goal. The math is simple: ➜ It costs us around $3 to register a new voter ➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we can register 10,000 new voters ➜ Polls show a major shift going on, and Michelle's work can truly impact 2024's elections Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful . Will you chip in $36 or more today to help register 12 new voters? [] GIVE $36 NOW ➜ [] Michelle Obama knows the score. She's compared modern voter suppression tactics to “poll taxes, literacy tests, and laws designed to strip away [our] power,” and said that “we must give Congress no choice but to act decisively to protect the right to vote and make the ballot box more accessible for everyone.” This is when we need to pull out all the stops. There's so much on the line in 2024, with just months to go before Election Day. Registering more than 1 million new voters this year could make the difference between opponents of voting rights taking charge to codify voter suppression for the next decade or having the votes we need to end the filibuster and pass sweeping new voting rights laws. Team: Your $36 goes directly to forging a more inclusive democracy by registering 12 new voters and making sure every single vote counts. Jacky is a tireless champion for hardworking families like the one I grew up in. She has been a fierce advocate for reproductive rights, comprehensive immigration reform, and gun safety legislation. She has also been a steadfast defender of healthcare, opposing efforts to repeal the Affordable Care Act and gut Medicaid funding.
**But she’s also the most vulnerable woman in the Senate right now. Experts say that the outcome of her race will decide whether Democrats maintain control of the Senate.** If we lose, we will cede power to Republicans who will strip away the fundamental freedoms that you and I care about so passionately.

For me, that meant getting my start by leading my church choir. And for Jacky, that meant getting recruited to run in a competitive House race while serving as the president of the largest synagogue in Nevada. And there’s one more thing we have in common that is urgently important in this moment:
We both believe in a vision of America where love triumphs over hate, where every individual has the opportunity to thrive, and where our government works for the people, not special interests. This vision is what drives us to ensure Democrats defend the Senate.

body:
Trump used veterans’ graves for political clout. The right-wing wants to bury the story.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91854844/495188605/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjJlMzVjOTAtZmI2Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rJQsjLdaLvbh8dEsywqpY0n39tbN_ggcd-aCd19876o=&emci=4137628a-fb66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=22e35c90-fb66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
You may have heard by now of Trump's visit to Arlington Cemetery on Monday. If not, here’s what you need to know:
* Officials explicitly warned the Trump team that campaigning at the cemetery was forbidden.
* While at the cemetery, Trump and his team got into an “altercation” with an official who was trying to enforce the cemetery’s rules.
* On Tuesday, the Trump campaign posted content from Trump’s visit, including a photo of Trump smiling and giving a thumbs-up at the grave of a fallen soldier.

So how is the right-wing media covering the controversy? **They’re not. They are actively trying to help Trump cover it up.**
[**We’ll explain more in a moment, but we are less than 48 hours away from our end-of-month deadline. Can you chip in $25 now to help us reach our $40,000 fundraising goal?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91854845/495188606/-593472309?refcode=20240830-EM-TrumpArlington&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjJlMzVjOTAtZmI2Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rJQsjLdaLvbh8dEsywqpY0n39tbN_ggcd-aCd19876o=)
Peter: this is just another incident in a long pattern of Donald Trump disrespecting the military, veterans, and fallen soldiers.
**Trump famously attacked late Senator John McCain for being captured in war in 2015, insulted Gold Star families in 2016, and called fallen soldiers “suckers” and “losers” in 2018.**
But you won’t hear these stories on _Fox News_ and in the right-wing press.
Instead, _Fox News_ hosts are spinning the controversy in an attempt to make it all look good for Trump.
Fox Business host David Asman, Fox & Friends co-host Brian Kilmeade, and Fox host Jeanine Pirro all praised Trump for visiting the cemetery, and criticized Kamala Harris for not doing the same – even though Trump’s visit was in clear violation of the rules.
On _X_ , the increasingly right-wing social media site owned by Trump-backer Elon Musk, the story was marked as “potentially spammy or unsafe,” a strange warning readers saw when they clicked on the article link.
**While the right-wing media bends over backward to paint Donald Trump as an eagle-loving, flag-hugging patriot, COURIER is telling the truth about Trump’s history of disrespecting military service. **
That’s because we are committed to providing a factual alternative to the right-wing echo chamber.
We know that quality journalism is harder to find than ever, and we know right-wing media, like _Fox News_ and increasingly _X_ , are doing everything to fill that void with propaganda and lies.
The good news is that COURIER has newsrooms up and running in the states that will decide this upcoming election. With your help, we can fight back and make journalism a force for good in our democracy.

clean_body: Trump used veterans’ graves for political clout. The right-wing wants to bury the story. Peter, You may have heard by now of Trump's visit to Arlington Cemetery on Monday. If not, here’s what you need to know: Officials explicitly warned the Trump team that campaigning at the cemetery was forbidden. While at the cemetery, Trump and his team got into an “altercation” with an official who was trying to enforce the cemetery’s rules. On Tuesday, the Trump campaign posted content from Trump’s visit, including a photo of Trump smiling and giving a thumbs-up at the grave of a fallen soldier. So how is the right-wing media covering the controversy? They’re not. They are actively trying to help Trump cover it up. = Peter: this is just another incident in a long pattern of Donald Trump disrespecting the military, veterans, and fallen soldiers. Trump famously attacked late Senator John McCain for being captured in war in 2015, insulted Gold Star families in 2016, and called fallen soldiers “suckers” and “losers” in 2018. But you won’t hear these stories on Fox News and in the right-wing press. Instead, Fox News hosts are spinning the controversy in an attempt to make it all look good for Trump. Fox Business host David Asman, Fox & Friends co-host Brian Kilmeade, and Fox host Jeanine Pirro all praised Trump for visiting the cemetery, and criticized Kamala Harris for not doing the same – even though Trump’s visit was in clear violation of the rules. On X , the increasingly right-wing social media site owned by Trump-backer Elon Musk, the story was marked as “potentially spammy or unsafe,” a strange warning readers saw when they clicked on the article link. While the right-wing media bends over backward to paint Donald Trump as an eagle-loving, flag-hugging patriot, COURIER is telling the truth about Trump’s history of disrespecting military service. * **Pennsylvania ranks 31st in the nation with a grade of C for women’s reproductive freedoms.** As a life-long advocate for women’s reproductive freedom, Kate vows to protect and advance women’s reproductive health and self-determination by ensuring only women and their healthcare providers are empowered to make those decisions.
* **More than 80% of Americans support common-sense gun safety legislation.** Kate will work to keep guns out of the wrong hands with universal background checks, established red flag laws, waiting periods, and a ban on bump stocks and high-capacity magazines.
* **Pennsylvania has one of the largest gaps in educational spending in the country, which is especially noticeable in her Senate District 47.** While Governor Shapiro has made progress in this category through his 2024-2025 budget, Kate believes there is still work to do to reduce disparities. Kate is determined to fight for more funding.
* **Currently, the minimum wage in PA is still $7.25. Retail and service industry jobs are very often women who are not making enough to support themselves and their families.** Kate knows how important it is to change that for women, families, and ALL workers in her state.

**Dear Texas Flyover Reader,** Try a little experiment today. Visit the homepage of an legacy news media company, and look for a headline that isn't heavily biased. (I just tried it, and I found exactly one on the front page. Yikes!) Bias is the new status quo in American news media, and it's the reason we started **_The Texas Flyover_**. We had a feeling that millions of Americans hate the spin-factories as much as we do, and now **170,000** \+ of you read our editions each morning. We've received tens of thousand of letters encouraging us to keep going, and we truly appreciate your support. Here's the deal. For **_The Texas Flyover_** to continue its mission, I need your help. Our advertisers cover some of our costs, but the direct support of our readers gets us across the finish line. clean_body: | | | | | Dear Texas Flyover Reader, Try a little experiment today. Visit the homepage of an legacy news media company, and look for a headline that isn't heavily biased. (I just tried it, and I found exactly one on the front page. Yikes!) Bias is the new status quo in American news media, and it's the reason we started The Texas Flyover. We had a feeling that millions of Americans hate the spin-factories as much as we do, and now 170,000 \+ of you read our editions each morning. We've received tens of thousand of letters encouraging us to keep going, and we truly appreciate your support. Here's the deal. For The Texas Flyover to continue its mission, I need your help. Our advertisers cover some of our costs, but the direct support of our readers gets us across the finish line. We're 100% free (and always will be), and to keep it that way, we're asking for those who are able to contribute to do so. I know some of you are on fixed incomes and can't contribute, and for some a $15 contribution is a sacrificial gift. Any amount will help us continue to bring you unbiased news--while meeting our financial commitments by August 31st. I love coming to work each morning knowing that hundreds of thousands of Americans enjoy our work, and I hope we get to do it for a long, long time. Thanks for your support! -Cole, CEO | | The Texas Flyover 448 W 19th St. Suite #356 Houston, TX 77008 | ---|---
