subject: Now that I’m back in Vermont, I wanted to share some thoughts with you.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Becca Balint for Vermont
body:
While I was thrilled by the energy and enthusiasm last week, the biggest delight came from seeing something reflect that I have felt for years:

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91857061/495195713/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YmE1Zjk2Zi1mZTY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3dG1e3RhyBODS0wkNPf7Hfgm-bL1tMuDjTwHNNc9w4w=&emci=74fb0aed-1966-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=4ba5f96f-fe66-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=43402272) | Hi Peter, Being at the DNC with my team was every bit as energizing and inspiring as I had imagined – and then some! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91857062/495195714/-484502953?&refcode=E10254-20240830-DNC-Image-2024Race&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YmE1Zjk2Zi1mZTY2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3dG1e3RhyBODS0wkNPf7Hfgm-bL1tMuDjTwHNNc9w4w=) And now that I’m back in Vermont, I wanted to share some thoughts with you. There was joy, there was excitement. But the more powerful and more lasting take away from the DNC was the feeling that we don’t actually want to hate our neighbors. This is something Vermonters have been saying for years. It hurts us mentally, emotionally and physically, and it makes us doubt that there is any goodness left in the world. **The Harris-Walz ticket has tapped into something that has been bubbling for years. We are starved for more joy because we know grievance politics do not serve us.** When I ran for Congress and crisscrossed Vermont making the case for my candidacy, I heard from so many voters that they were exhausted from politics based on hate and fear. They’d say to me, “I don’t want to hate my neighbors.” People wanted to be able to talk to their neighbors about ideas and opinions and not have it be so damn personal. They weren’t blind to the fact that there are real policy disagreements that inflame passions, but they could see that the constant onslaught of fear, anger and hatred was hurting us – individually and as a nation. **I adopted the slogan “Courage and Kindness” for my campaign to reflect how I felt and what voters were telling me. It feels better in our bodies and minds to have a positive outlook, and we want more of that.** I saw this feeling and focus build throughout the week of the convention. Americans are ready to turn the page on the negativity and grievance that has gripped so many for so long. We want to be a nation once again focused on freedom – and the joy that comes from that freedom. And this November, we’ll move forward – together – as a nation and elect Kamala Harris. Let’s do this! Becca

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: We had to make a really tough call. Hear me out.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Some dark money group — backing Trump and Kari Lake — just released a rush of attack ads aimed at tearing me down and propping Kari Lake up.
#

Peter, it’s Ruben.
I’m about to level with you on something that I hope you won’t share. We’ve had to make a really tough call in the last 48 hours, and I need you to hear about it.
Some dark money group — backing Trump and Kari Lake — just released a rush of attack ads aimed at tearing me down and propping Kari Lake up. They’ve put more than $8 million behind them. Can you give whatever you can now to help us take on the corporate PACs spending millions to support my opponent? [] As you might’ve seen yesterday, I debated my opponent for the first time this cycle. | | Dear Friends and Supporters, This past week has been a busy and rewarding one, filled with important discussions that are shaping the future of our community.
On Saturday, we were out talking directly with voters, hearing their concerns, and sharing our vision for a better tomorrow. It’s clear that people are hungry for change, and it was uplifting to see the enthusiasm and support firsthand.
---
---
On Sunday, I had the privilege of meeting with members of the Indian American community. We had an engaging discussion about the importance of healthcare and immigration—two issues that are close to my heart.
---
|
---
---
|
---
**It’s conversations like these that remind me why I’m in this race: to fight for a future where everyone has access to quality healthcare and a fair shot at the American Dream.**
Monday was a day of important engagements. I attended the Lenexa Planning Commission meeting, where the proposed Johnson County homeless shelter was discussed. As a Christian, I believe it is our duty to help our neighbors who are struggling, but I also believe we must find the right solutions that serve our entire community.
---
|
---
---
|
---
Later that evening, I spoke to members of the Asian American Hotel Owners Association, where we discussed the critical role that small businesses play in our economy and how we can support their growth and success.
---
|
---
---
|
---
Throughout the week, I continued to engage with voters, attending meetings in Wyandotte County and Anderson County. Each of these meetings reinforced my belief that the people of our district are ready for leadership that listens and acts.
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
|
---
On Thursday morning, I had the opportunity to attend the Eggs and Issues event hosted by the Shawnee Chamber of Commerce. We talked about some tough topics, including how inflation is driving up the costs of city services, the impact of property taxes on residents, and the importance of community development. These are challenges that we must address head-on to ensure that our communities remain vibrant and strong. **As we look ahead, I’m excited to share that our campaign team will be participating in the De Soto Days Parade on Saturday and the Louisburg Parade on Monday.** These events are a fantastic opportunity to connect with even more of you, and I look forward to seeing you there.
Thank you for your continued support and commitment. Together, we are building a campaign that is truly for the people. Let’s keep this momentum going as we work toward a better future.

clean_body: | | | | | Dear Friends and Supporters, This past week has been a busy and rewarding one, filled with important discussions that are shaping the future of our community. On Saturday, we were out talking directly with voters, hearing their concerns, and sharing our vision for a better tomorrow. It’s clear that people are hungry for change, and it was uplifting to see the enthusiasm and support firsthand. On Sunday, I had the privilege of meeting with members of the Indian American community. We had an engaging discussion about the importance of healthcare and immigration—two issues that are close to my heart. | | It’s conversations like these that remind me why I’m in this race: to fight for a future where everyone has access to quality healthcare and a fair shot at the American Dream. Monday was a day of important engagements. I attended the Lenexa Planning Commission meeting, where the proposed Johnson County homeless shelter was discussed. As a Christian, I believe it is our duty to help our neighbors who are struggling, but I also believe we must find the right solutions that serve our entire community. | | Later that evening, I spoke to members of the Asian American Hotel Owners Association, where we discussed the critical role that small businesses play in our economy and how we can support their growth and success. | | Throughout the week, I continued to engage with voters, attending meetings in Wyandotte County and Anderson County. Each of these meetings reinforced my belief that the people of our district are ready for leadership that listens and acts. | | | On Thursday morning, I had the opportunity to attend the Eggs and Issues event hosted by the Shawnee Chamber of Commerce. We talked about some tough topics, including how inflation is driving up the costs of city services, the impact of property taxes on residents, and the importance of community development. These are challenges that we must address head-on to ensure that our communities remain vibrant and strong. As we look ahead, I’m excited to share that our campaign team will be participating in the De Soto Days Parade on Saturday and the Louisburg Parade on Monday. These events are a fantastic opportunity to connect with even more of you, and I look forward to seeing you there. Thank you for your continued support and commitment. Together, we are building a campaign that is truly for the people. Let’s keep this momentum going as we work toward a better future. Friends,
The choice in this election is now clear. It's the future versus the past. It's hope versus fear. It’s middle out versus top down. It's special interests versus Suffolk County families.
The stakes are far higher than the victory of any one political party. We need to build a broad, patriotic coalition to defend American democracy. We need to focus on rebuilding the middle – rebuilding the middle of our economy, and rebuilding the middle of our politics. How do we do this? Not just by firing up the base, but by reaching out. Especially in a swing district like NY-01, we need to win over independent voters, and even some Republicans in this effort to return our nation to a spirit of common sense problem solving that pursues the common good.
From the beginning of this campaign, I've been saying that we need to be happy warriors fighting the good fight. Participating in American democracy should be a joyful process in which we ultimately focus on what unites us not what divides us. Yes, we’re fighting for Long Island. But we’re also fighting for democracy, the next generation, and the future of this country.
We have less than 70 days to turn the page and write a great new chapter in American history together.
That change begins at home, here in New York’s First Congressional District.
So dig deep. Volunteer. Knock on every door and donate – believe me, it is cheaper than regret. Together we'll prove that the positive defeats the negative, and together we'll build something positive on the other side of Trumpism: a government guided by common sense problem solving for hardworking families across Suffolk County and the United States of America.
Thank you for standing with me in this fight. I’m happy you’re here. Now let's go win an election.
-John

President Trump was just in Montana to help rally the troops, and earlier this month, a new public poll was released showing my race within the margin of error and too close to call. This race is getting more expensive every day and is shaping up to be the most expensive Senate race in the country. This is an irrefutable fact. Since April, the last time I wrote to you about the average donation to our campaign, we've closed the polling gap and built a formidable campaign operation, but we still haven't been able to close the fundraising gap with the Democrats. But don’t take my word for it - $120 million in advertising has already been reserved on Montana airwaves, with tens of millions more soon. Here is why \- our average July Donation. My career politician opponent not only votes with Biden/Harris 95% of the time and tries to cover it up back here at home, but he’s also the top Senate fundraiser in the country.And every fundraising quarter he shatters the previous fundraising record his campaign set. Your help today will enable me to keep spreading my conservative America First message to voters while fighting back against the lies that career politician Jon Tester pushes out against me. My time as a Navy SEAL taught me the cost of service and sacrifice; I will bring my battle-tested leadership to the United States Senate and be a voice every American can count on to consistently put voters' interests FIRST. I’m in this race to bring common sense back to Washington, D.C. and save our country. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=c863a5676078472198038a2e44ed3c35&_e=zPDDctxPopBSiwoa1_RG12u5sx1lwmDKwcgyqYS-z3iGr7-imP559I5GgVUBWqd10RnpdjZmRyP5wZLZwHoMmZ4Gciz0WA4BwMZ1i5VoGL8NjXFjrevHRzb4a7XHAcf1n4qTQbYxympBfQ94aWmrlmAL-6Zq6jXkAQdQ6MVP9VR8ap3eUMvTg81HB7-WVsyHlymRMrSLkRunL4MUAd4gsBDVNiQZmbLW7Hn8KwkWlkfI8u4hgEfoTI_FLaOzb_OXGskwYe81dHB8WCN5nC-zQSmbzcEeaDaFB4X5sbJ3U5ol4mOYeDJONtd3Oaf6laymELYnNgqSDW0FclTLTHMihYz0KK-C9yla1iVv7w4eI8IBQO7HGZiU1PitgBa_1CV1cqWXTXYdnfqiTM3RivtuaDedEfR_gIXR1ihNlWjGtDs%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

_**✏️ 2024 IREAD Assessment Score Increases! 📈**_
---
**Indiana's third grade literacy rates increased for the third consecutive year** according to [results released](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=f8df5bcb1760416f84399ce1b10cfe9c&_e=jJNeqx_40W6S1CPczz49ohcDcqwlvqcZ6OJGDUQJ1D9-n2SvWsXksPHBB6daxcuaZpyIqm8UITy2Jjh3wrKs69jf_20vK7NFcyAsNhGPKF895ki-IMx6jeoqr0gsG7nPGYMXEwbbcgZqMsE6tKPoZ1OawXv_6mMdSwOs2uM6fJ0qW2tRXN7jy4CT_MAPG3aDZL2zk-wY4ecCMeNuXJ5tnbTdxsEtvV3i6R5AHIUKAPntYjH5zg4FEDhvZI7KLrFD_q2R0dcjswhs5Z1UWjCbNw%3D%3D) from the 2023-2024 Indiana Reading Evaluation and Determination (IREAD) assessment. This is amazing news as Republican leaders have continued to make historic literacy investments over the last several years. Due to Republican leadership in the General Assembly and the leadership of Indiana's Secretary of Education, Dr. Katie Jenner, Hoosier literacy is heading back in the right direction. Results Recap:
---
* Prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, Indiana’s literacy rates declined every year, with the exception of 2014 to 2015.
* Literacy rates have now increased for three consecutive years.
* This year represents the largest-ever single-year increase since the start of IREAD in 2013.
* Literacy rates for Black students, students in special education, and students receiving free/reduced price meals have increased for three consecutive years.
* The number of schools proactively testing IREAD in second grade has nearly tripled - this allows teachers to have an indicator for student performance before the third grade IREAD tests.
* Starting this year, all second graders will proactively take the IREAD test.
* With the help of this early indicator, educators were able to identify students needing interventions to master foundational reading skills, allowing 56% of second graders who were identified as at-risk in 2023 to pass IREAD in 2024.
* Indiana partnered with Lilly Endowment, Inc. to invest up to $111 million to support early literacy development. This investment was recently expanded by the Indiana General Assembly during the 2023 legislative session, resulting in a combined total investment of $170 million.

---
The COVID-19 pandemic interfered with learning for students across the country, and Indiana was no exception. Thanks to the leadership of Secretary Jenner and the General Assembly, we are witnessing a rebound in childhood literacy. Education remains a priority for Republicans. In order to continue to see this level of improvement, it is important that we elect Republicans up and down the ballot in November!

This is amazing news as Republican leaders have continued to make historic literacy investments over the last several years. Due to Republican leadership in the General Assembly and the leadership of Indiana's Secretary of Education, Dr. Katie Jenner, Hoosier literacy is heading back in the right direction. Results Recap: Prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, Indiana’s literacy rates declined every year, with the exception of 2014 to 2015. Literacy rates have now increased for three consecutive years. This year represents the largest-ever single-year increase since the start of IREAD in 2013. Literacy rates for Black students, students in special education, and students receiving free/reduced price meals have increased for three consecutive years. The number of schools proactively testing IREAD in second grade has nearly tripled - this allows teachers to have an indicator for student performance before the third grade IREAD tests. Starting this year, all second graders will proactively take the IREAD test. With the help of this early indicator, educators were able to identify students needing interventions to master foundational reading skills, allowing 56% of second graders who were identified as at-risk in 2023 to pass IREAD in 2024. Indiana partnered with Lilly Endowment, Inc. to invest up to $111 million to support early literacy development. This investment was recently expanded by the Indiana General Assembly during the 2023 legislative session, resulting in a combined total investment of $170 million. The COVID-19 pandemic interfered with learning for students across the country, and Indiana was no exception. Thanks to the leadership of Secretary Jenner and the General Assembly, we are witnessing a rebound in childhood literacy. Education remains a priority for Republicans. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1853%2E135344%2EB4suf8)

Friend -
If you were waiting for the perfect time to make your first donation to my campaign for Senate, before our August fundraising deadline, not only is today the perfect day but there's also a very good reason as well.
Betsy DeVos.
If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in, please use this link to give:
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/beat-devos](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240830-3-900&t=2&akid=1853%2E135344%2EB4suf8)**
Otherwise, let me go a little deeper .., including a very recent revelation about her designs on a role in a second Trump administration.
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and one of his longest serving cabinet secretaries.
Much like our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, she condemned Donald Trump after January 6, 2021. In Betsy DeVos’ case, she “resigned in protest” as Education Secretary, blaming his rhetoric on the insurrection -- just 13 days before the end of Trump’s term.
And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back -- and willing to serve in a second Trump administration.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240830-3-900&t=3&akid=1853%2E135344%2EB4suf8)
So what does that mean?
As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.
And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan.
The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race.
Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. And just last week, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable just a day before the primary election.
They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent.
On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways.
So in light of this news about Betsy DeVos' potential return to Washington, D.C. and her role in campaigning for my opponent, I am asking:
[**Can you contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan before our August fundraising deadline tomorrow? I will put your donation made today in Betsy’s name right to work persuading the voters we need to win in Michigan this fall.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240830-3-900&t=4&akid=1853%2E135344%2EB4suf8)

[](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkbuO3DAMRb9G7mToZY-nUBHAcJVNkSalQVP0rAA9DFnaQfL1gTcbpEmzJclDAof3x8v6Aj749PgGkeweylrONW5rCti4I3DBJ-Ih57gqoQwXE9dilZ2zQt6dMR1ZeVODMPdxkN2r3VEasWvlBrejmcxEm1M3gQ6l04PcOm-vO2LSQt7NYMYeEHEwYqdRw4h0Y0ZAoFL7vRC5HCG54Dcq9WehI5faY45dsK-1HifTX5hamFpOwlaof_pUyF0EU0uC6nOCwDGns_raPsoAT96Sz-liMDQe4K1Q-vVPN278yAcwvbQa1zO3gsT0_F-YqfGCIjnfItPz--KfXkWm5-Xrd83_Kn8MEOIB_pGYnuPG1Agxt1SZntXQFeuOpw_Bn-P1ikcEH96V6yfSebPqdwAAAP__21idIA) Dear Patriot,

On September 12th, Rebecca Lavrenz must pay her fine of $103,000 to the Biden/Harris Justice Department.

Rebecca is the 72-year-old great-grandmother and faithful Christian who entered the Capital building with a group for several minutes, caused no harm, and left when she was asked.

**[Please help Rebecca pay this outrageous fine and the cost of her appeal.](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkbuO3DAMRb9G7mToZY-nUBHAcJVNkSalQVP0rAA9DFnaQfL1gTcbpEmzJclDAof3x8v6Aj749PgGkeweylrONW5rCti4I3DBJ-Ih57gqoQwXE9dilZ2zQt6dMR1ZeVODMPdxkN2r3VEasWvlBrejmcxEm1M3gQ6l04PcOm-vO2LSQt7NYMYeEHEwYqdRw4h0Y0ZAoFL7vRC5HCG54Dcq9WehI5faY45dsK-1HifTX5hamFpOwlaof_pUyF0EU0uC6nOCwDGns_raPsoAT96Sz-liMDQe4K1Q-vVPN278yAcwvbQa1zO3gsT0_F-YqfGCIjnfItPz--KfXkWm5-Xrd83_Kn8MEOIB_pGYnuPG1Agxt1SZntXQFeuOpw_Bn-P1ikcEH96V6yfSebPqdwAAAP__21idIA)**

Mrs. Lavrenz was sentenced to six months of house arrest, 12 months of probation, and the largest fine for a misdemeanor in history--$103,000!

As her attorney, I knew a guilty verdict was impossible to avoid given the politics of this case, so I fought hard to avoid jail time for Rebecca.

While we succeeded in keeping a great-grandmother out of jail, Judge Zia Faruqui wanted to make an example of Rebecca and silence her voice ahead of the November elections, so in addition to the fine and punishment, he added a provision that Rebecca is BANNED from the Internet.

She cannot use email, post on X or Facebook, or log in to join a podcast.

Rebecca cannot even access the online reservation system for her bed and breakfast, her primary source of income.

She needs our help to pay this looming fine and cover the costs of the appeal we are working on, **[so please donate as much as you can today to ensure Rebecca is not penalized even more for failing to pay the fine](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkbuO3DAMRb9G7mToZY-nUBHAcJVNkSalQVP0rAA9DFnaQfL1gTcbpEmzJclDAof3x8v6Aj749PgGkeweylrONW5rCti4I3DBJ-Ih57gqoQwXE9dilZ2zQt6dMR1ZeVODMPdxkN2r3VEasWvlBrejmcxEm1M3gQ6l04PcOm-vO2LSQt7NYMYeEHEwYqdRw4h0Y0ZAoFL7vRC5HCG54Dcq9WehI5faY45dsK-1HifTX5hamFpOwlaof_pUyF0EU0uC6nOCwDGns_raPsoAT96Sz-liMDQe4K1Q-vVPN278yAcwvbQa1zO3gsT0_F-YqfGCIjnfItPz--KfXkWm5-Xrd83_Kn8MEOIB_pGYnuPG1Agxt1SZntXQFeuOpw_Bn-P1ikcEH96V6yfSebPqdwAAAP__21idIA).**

Since Rebecca is banned from the Internet by Judge Faruqui, I wanted to share her words directly with you:

| ❝
---
Saddened that the current government administration and 'justice' system who call themselves the 'United States of America' want to silence me by sentencing me to home detention and banning me from the Internet for six months, but grateful that family and a multitude of others are now stepping up to carry my voice further to 'Make America Godly Again'!

\- Rebecca Lavrenz

Since graduating from Harvard Law, I have been a top litigator, representing cases worth billions of dollars. My organization, the National Constitutional Law Union, has represented dozens of January 6th defendants to the best of our ability.

In my decades as an attorney, I have never experienced such brazen words from a judge to a defendant. Judge Faruqui called into question Rebecca's Christian values and even her dedication to her children and grandchildren.

His words still echo in my head, and I must share them again.

During sentencing, Judge Faruqui looked at Rebecca and scolded her by saying, "I don't know why being the J6 Praying Grandmother is more important than being an actual grandmother." He then said, "Your faith is being misplaced right now."

body:
Are we the only campaign you get emails from?
#
Hey Derek, quick question:
Are we the only campaign you get emails from? We’re betting the answer to that is a resounding “nope.”
In fact, you probably get a _lot_ of emails from a _lot_ of different campaigns and organizations. And if we’re still betting, a lot of those emails from other folks probably don’t treat you with the respect you deserve.
**They may even treat you more like a piggy bank than a valued supporter. 🙄**
Look, every campaign, including this one, has to raise money ([**so please, pitch in to support ours if you can**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240830-2?refcode=em20240830-2&amount=5&refcode2=9327_434096_eX2TMq&akid=9327%2E434096%2EeX2TMq)). But here are just a few examples of the kind of scammy, dishonest tactics you’ll _never_ see from John:
_**“URGENT: FINAL NOTICE ENCLOSED”
**_ _**“4X MATCH ACTIVE!”
**_ _**“DONATE NOW OR WE WILL LOSE!”**_
We don’t engage in that kind of BS because we know you’re _not_ a piggy bank. **You’re a real person** , with a real job, a real life, and real concerns. And you deserve to be treated like one too.
So while we do count on grassroots donations to keep this campaign running, we’ll always be up front and honest about what we’re asking for and why.
**Here’s why we’re asking today: Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is at midnight tomorrow, and we still need a little help to reach our goal. Reaching these goals is REALLY important if we want to keep this seat 🔵.**
[**So if you can, please pitch in $5 before midnight tomorrow to help us reach our August goal. We do need your help, but we promise to never try and trick you into donating.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240830-2?refcode=em20240830-2&amount=5&refcode2=9327_434096_eX2TMq&akid=9327%2E434096%2EeX2TMq)

Thanks,
Team Fetterman

Hi friend,
At the Democratic National Convention last week, one word kept coming up: freedom .
As Americans, we may disagree about how to address certain problems, but the problems themselves are matters of fact. Inequality is growing. Social mobility is at a standstill. Proper health care is beyond the reach of tens of millions. So is a good education and life lived in safety.
If we are to truly create a fair, just country, I believe every American must have access to four essential freedoms.
Freedom to rise — Our policies need to value workers and working families, not generational wealth.
Freedom to learn — Without a good education, mobility and justice are out of reach for the next generation.
Freedom from violence — Violence affects our everyday lives, and it affects our children the most. We should live in a country unburdened by senseless gun violence, addiction, and the quiet cruelty that flourishes on social media.
Freedom to govern ourselves — Voter suppression, gerrymandering, the influx of dark money, and partisanship in Congress shut too many voices out of our system, putting our democracy at risk.
Last week, we shared a vision for this country where our freedoms are protected and everyone has a fair shot to succeed.
We have less than 70 days to make sure Democrats across the country, from local school board candidates in Colorado to Vice President Kamala Harris, have the support and resources they need to win.
Your support will be essential to safeguarding our Senate majority and taking back the House this November. Will you help my campaign hit our fundraising goal before our fundraising deadline tomorrow? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_083024_EOM_A_4F_act]

Hey there,
**The U.S. Senate is a country club.** It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me.
**If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate.** I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life.
**I will be the only senator without a college degree.** After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table.
**I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member.** When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike.
There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: **FOUR new polls show I am neck-and-neck with my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. One even shows me LEADING by 2 points!**
I’ve taken on a big corporation before and won, and now I’m going to defeat one of the most corporate senators – my opponent Republican Deb Fischer – and win this Senate seat in November. But I need your help to do it.
**We’ve set a goal of raising another $100,000 before our end-of-month fundraising deadline at midnight tomorrow, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs like my opponent. As a mom of 6, I decided to run for Congress because we desperately need more people in Washington who understand what everyday families go through. People who will advocate for children and education, defend the right to choose, and deliver for the hardworking people of Michigan.
**With your help, we have made some astounding progress on this campaign.** We’ve brought together a strong and powerful coalition of supporters who are _done_ with politicians more focused on scoring political points than helping their constituents, and who are willing to fight to put real leaders in Congress.
**That brings us to tomorrow's deadline.** After a commanding victory in the primary, we’ve made it to our first fundraising deadline of the general election. We’re running in one of the closest Congressional races in the country, and with Democrats just four seats away from the House majority, we have a real chance of taking back the House if we win here in MI-08. But my opponent and the National GOP are working _hard_ to stop our momentum — my opponent is using his trust fund to spend a whopping $300,000 EVERY SINGLE WEEK on attack ads against me — and the only way we can fight back is if our coalition steps up to ensure we hit we hit each and every fundraising benchmark – starting with tomorrow night.

Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F-AbKngyyV46GAPgD9xr2dvIYHF8pJBvT0s4j_WzF_6ojsZNYJeC5g6iaKscxBCqs056psBoS-j_CBz9a2sNkM9HfaRU3OGp7EmQ19OuqYZkva45HboLk8iomtfTF-6jZa7z8MR-M3zw_UEs_HTXv7I%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F1nU-vQ0cl9WQ4IhSdI7IvaqiatMcFY1wE5C0aUx1DoNjihQg2lnCQqwX0XJzx1apRtSY9DXNHmn7jUj-no684xYNuhBl4vXtTwaG3tBHQVhtnWqNEQ7heomm5Hhjh0nXURzC2zgFHvegAnOwiZjmUk%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F0nr6wFVhlKekpAF1NKqjVhGDToHkq3xa073Y30SYpPAaTI51MX4FmBx32VbHFkcIC0NmEcMR59RoRYRecgNdLCO1S06KRW5Cfpn5dE1_EnPuSvNZBz3Cz6XBd-iB5arSpGXQoyoNYiw2Bb-oAbPFFI%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij96d8djXO1CSrhzIkrqCkQ-zD6jBksGZfeD93-P5XzdL25FOYg3JbS3QuhI8sD88M2iUnAB14z62dilHOkhQcCXSdFobJGiBWiveT69E1LLu72tzmBi_5YVKXUfqFwHraEzwqsh9QdMZFVp_hgsmN2vpV1aSzod8guCqWseqI95v5Pe_GqQBYZKq_vxQVn01UMKolwPgw7EVMYfH32jXBu4IFBT93Wm9GdlWbK5Auts1BkBYT56Wd9djjV7W-qnozCjELsHybckVdL3UWpWF5MMkgBJgRtTfpbvzK2jx1F5WNu8Iosjwjk7yxxDkSpBFL3JmWrxAttXfA5Jy8hDrHbStQY_GlgJJs4s6XAkUjYLqI%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F7y_GNLnwlT3Vj_OWJ115OXsZi0kkTdB5qd9eSh8Wmx6_2Jipi2IC8pU8f6XC5fNUonQxvuo9gSbkRtbJaUeznMNhfYJOVg-dcKKnJwaNgpFcCx5u7VL9cKFvNm5aOYR6cgyTb7Ta109oMkghYDwEC4%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F667bil36CNgtuzKZni6TfPGRaszFymZJ8hyiWH9_Oy5R8Wsgc3iXO-9JgKC5GsXbYsDO41pAsqaMDEMdWsQLq1ei_KcVnbQd6DNpucwq0Ksk78GiZoFUhERZELQwgB5KZB4ICRTjlrZ2Ct8F4IgrfI%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4Fz1uk5QTcIqNJUOf1XZdqEGrdRLDcWfB28A9XRsni92zvyo1gpUyXOdptOBSwH4qFOz5naKfYVJLuEUfKjNvZHkdkLhuwSQonR_5cYSJkBY_f8nkxQ3pWqz4D6Ou4oCU7MAWOp8hwhqpEMnzymnH0Bs%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F9w7rPQgHtp_f-SfSK2UrA0aUSyqRkNvzS0iyKa9WmCg_zuwmyz58SGUETsyq5eNUuOxVsOi-LFq6LNbmVRO7DPy_ZhDRYlducIksKVwnuYfog1jGR2eT3lGlrOvSQUyC9MNhNmhOZmHH-K6tCfHXu0%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F0W_c5vEI5Rmm89dZ3e7gVwuSCzdx92LFU-n5NraG6kMRYn5dT94rWKpKSVhKvg4SQUbz1f3PfqEtYfW9M_vlVizQiYQ87rKRUTFDwf0F3T2WrhqhGLUYyRuXAaZaXpzniDLiT43Kv7j_8uhJVSYXQM%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

[**HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT
ELECT A FIGHTER TO THE U.S. SENATE->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c8e1b55e7f4940a5349b9324b9029f&_e=-IW1TFE4lLBIl3ECcH4UurWnxNiCcZ53l090HwlWiWxA34tvGnCw0HrJ4aHg_Ij9H_tzLWRYZnamlwE__LGcusLQ4Wq0lb8HGFcrF-OMpVZ2dBocPRdSMB_PUsBFwEnWGOu94ZvD0CWObrhlTrs2gg6tn_CLB3_WJjxYQ6q3gr8qVz6AY3uR0MPLmFvMjvm1C2cS7fOX6C24__mBI_FY4GfaWNTmPBpwU2JPevXMw-k9T2g5BZ0AKURR2Aj6wA-rEDwgWu_T8DxXG_oindd4F8iXeFqISrjeIBDfZlyoLnP9bXTo7Lgo2TchAGV0tzPttROZotz5L9Lnl5WSlcikz2y9AerG4nQGCdeD0XVwbO19jJaCp8Ohk-9tfvncT64OTRDbftqlUb2RKDR2llVM81kfC0n3OEkUbqnTU1EkWjk%3D)

"

I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. name: Jill Stein
subject: Reality check: The Harris Honeymoon is OVER
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_interview&n=1)
---
Peter,

This week Kamala Harris sat down for her first longform interview since entering the race for president – and it’s safe to say that she met our expectations.

After that dark, draconian, militaristic speech at the DNC, in which Harris promised **a militant border crackdown, endless weapons for Israel, and unlimited expansion of the American war machine** , we expected nothing less than for her to double down.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_interview&n=2)
---
Since Biden dropped out of the race and Harris became the nominee, our campaign has been targeted by an increasingly vitriolic liberal elite condemning our movement for people, planet, and peace.

They’ve called me every name under the sun, and attacked supporters like you – for the simple reason that we weren’t buying it.

The groundswell of “hope and change and joy” that surrounded Harris from the moment she entered the race came crashing down with **a hard reality check** last week at the DNC, confirmed in her responses to CNN’s Dana Bash this week.

**Harris has now fully revealed herself as an unabashed, militant right-winger who will carry on the proud Democratic tradition of catering to her corporate benefactors at the expense of our planet and everyone on it.

** They talk about being the party of freedom – but we know that none of us are free until ALL of us are free.

They talk about being the party of joy – but there is no joy in genocide.

**We don’t want “the most lethal fighting force” in the world. We want housing and healthcare and opportunities for ALL.

** We want a livable planet and a sustainable future, a SERIOUS and transformative plan to end our dependence on fossil fuels – not a pledge to continue fracking.

For the last few weeks we’ve been subjected to a mass propaganda campaign, but that’s over. She’s now told us in no uncertain terms who she is and how she will rule as president.

Following the catastrophic failure of the Democratic party to engage the uncommitted movement in good faith, and with the election fast approaching, millions of voters are seriously examining their options.

**[They need to hear from the ONLY campaign that shares their values with a path to the White House – ours – and we need your help to reach them. Can you give $25, $50, $100 or more today?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_interview&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_interview&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_interview&n=4)
---
Challenging empire begins at home. The leaders we elect set the tone for the terms on which we engage with the rest of the world. The casual brutality we see in Gaza today is being carried out by the same Israeli Occupation Forces that train many of our own civilian police officers. They won’t hesitate to use the same tactics against us – indeed, they already have.

The choice we have before us in November is a simple one. There are two candidates representing war and Wall Street, and only one representing the people.

**[We will deliver our mandate at the ballot box this November. Will you join us?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_interview&n=5)**

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

| Dear ,
August has been an incredibly busy month on the campaign trail!
**A Huge Thank You!**
We are deeply grateful to the more than 60 volunteers who meticulously hand-addressed, stuffed, sealed, and stamped over 18,000 envelopes for district households. These envelopes contained an introductory letter and magnetic football schedules for the Steelers, Pitt, and Penn State. The feedback from voters has been fantastic—unlike most political mail, our letter is being read and our campaign-themed football schedule is proudly displayed on many refrigerators. Your dedication to this effort is truly appreciated, and I couldn't have achieved this milestone without your hard work.
---
| **Great Community Events!**
August has been filled with wonderful community events. On Saturday, August 24th, I enjoyed the Bradford Woods Pancake Breakfast and Bike Parade, and later took my family to the Marshall Township Community Day. A heartfelt thank you to all the volunteers and staff who organize these events and make our community such a fantastic place to live.
---
| **New Office Location – 120 Church Rd, Wexford, PA 15090!**
We’re excited to announce our new office at 120 Church Rd in Wexford, conveniently located near Route 19 and Church Rd, close to Cole’s Tavern and directly across from Cenci’s Pizza. This space has already hosted several events, including our envelope-stuffing parties. Although our staffing is limited at the moment, we have campaign signs available. Feel free to stop by and pick up a yard sign if you need one.
**Knocking on Doors and More!**
We’ve been actively canvassing the district and are just 121 doors away from reaching the significant milestone of 10,000 doors knocked!
---
| **Volunteer Opportunities Available!**
There are numerous ways to contribute to the campaign, from addressing envelopes and distributing flyers to making yard signs and assisting at the office. If you’re interested in volunteering, please reply to this email for more details.
---
[DONATE](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=73d7286622&e=8c80cba7e7)
| Thank you for your continued support and dedication
With Gratitude,

body:

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4030%2E552475%2EfzqUXk)
Peter,
Here’s the truth: David McCormick, Donald Trump, and JD Vance are pulling out all the stops to flip Pennsylvania red. Their determination to win the Senate and the White House means that we are seeing unprecedented spending in our Commonwealth.
It’s a rare privilege to serve the people of Pennsylvania in the U.S. Senate, and I don’t take this responsibility for granted. Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator in Washington working for them and their families. It is an honor that they’ve trusted me to do just that.
It’s why we’re working hard to ensure that we can compete with the flood of dark money the other side is spending against us as we speak.
**[This moment matters. If you’re ready to help us hold this seat, chip in anything you can spare today — not next week, not next month, but today — to defend Pennsylvania’s Senate seat.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240830-3?refcode=em20240830-3&refcode2=4030_552475_fzqUXk&akid=4030%2E552475%2EfzqUXk)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240830-3?refcode=em20240830-3&refcode2=4030_552475_fzqUXk&akid=4030%2E552475%2EfzqUXk)**
This is the toughest race of my career, and we have a lot of work to do.
We’re up against a mega-millionaire who is self-funding his campaign, plus the combined forces of national Republicans desperate to win the White House and the Senate.
They’re committed to doing in 2024 what they almost did here in 2022 and 2020 — flip Pennsylvania red.
They didn’t win then, and Peter, they won’t win now. If we come together, we can continue making progress for the people of Pennsylvania.
**[Please, if you can, donate today. Your support will make a real difference.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240830-3?refcode=em20240830-3&refcode2=4030_552475_fzqUXk&akid=4030%2E552475%2EfzqUXk)**

body:
Are we at an inflection point in history?
| | | |
---
|
# August 28, 2024
---
|
# Democrat Kennedy endorses Republican Trump
---
| An inflection point is a moment of dramatic change. Most of us would agree that our beloved country is at an inflection point. Robert F. Kennedy Jr, much to the dismay of his famous family, endorsed Donald Trump for President. Kennedy recognized that America needed to be saved from a Party whose policies have made life difficult for "We the People" over the past three years.
This endorsement will cause an estimated 11% to 16% shift of the Democrat vote to Trump, which is a game changer in the swing states. While California is far from being a swing state, the fact that RFK Jr's VP pick Nicole Shanahan, a Bay Area tech attorney and philanthropist, also endorsed Trump, highlighting a shift in traditional Democrat vote patterns.
As a Republican running for Congress to represent Silicon Valley and the Central Coast, a 10% shift in Democrat vote makes my race, and those of other down ballot Republicans, far more winnable.
Are we at an inflection point where Silicon Valley could send a Republican to Congress?

---
| Closer to home other traditional Democrat voters are awakening. In the March 2024 Primary, Democrat Charlene Nijmeh, Tribal Chairwoman of the Muwekma Ohlone Tribe, ran against my opponent, Zoe Lofgren, because the incumbent Congresswoman was unfair in dealing with the Tribe. Democrat Chairwoman Nijmeh managed to take 11% of the vote away from Lofgren.
On August 13, 2024, the Muwekma Tribe held a rally on the steps of San Jose City Hall where Chairman Nijmeh gave me her endorsement.
---
|
---
Peter Hernandez (R) accepts competitor Charlene Nijmeh's (D) endorsement
---
| | |
---|---
"Adding to the political intrigue, Nijmeh, a Democrat, has endorsed Peter Hernandez, Lofgren's GOP challenger in the November election, who has pledged support for the Muwekma Ohlone's recognition efforts.

"Truth has a profound yet necessary effect," Hernandez said at a rally outside San Jose City Hall. "It requires clarity and accountability. And right now, the only ones opposed to the truth are the gatekeepers of California politics.""

[The Mercury News, August 27, 2024](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001U6ZL9hWgvK-VuLSZoESPJ6kWDevlBQiqwEuCufdDt3q211slMHYW20t2fEhPle1YrvzJ5KMlcQidA2ZJeosEQQGxgpy8MmoZH829H_NE55XLwNmfLbRPSkJ-t1U_hddGjt_RV2F_FJUw3RcSXSSve3a7rWxuNsLxEC-GnoNFa9a4pkF4Uof9OmCpeyxbSy2_kZD0OH41nih7I5uiTO-V2F7M9Laus9lHmkMi66bwX41Vh8bDqJJkNqii0DKeWyvazaDOLRgqw9vCvhOHTmikBypoRm9k3lDk0bN2N9SeuwL6VVrLw3PGU1P3ujZxy4S-uEA4mZVAZtJtbXuwOteHFHPA89R_NHVU8bCWYUrh06bGJyFPd2w4vhv8GeSPWULgzbfKgaxDsI1WM7a-eXkG-1QOpkCvbvgD_-LK3gLR10OiMe2MOKPWLUnLIw5cXMopQNW1t7IkbvJ7eHvwcXcVXkKUGIBdGpcWLDfwcLZBAN8jaQXZTmfftiwTDmZvUJ9e_bEfcPbNa7PhUk4PKYldmMSrEAmQ62o7GCeANW0-UDq0irNyzD14PHV4Sf6016o4-00sQFogpXD4AL9euuVHmSHae0Ghu42kWCgrHgvi60sTZ-vMXZgyoeWhpll1U_QduJiMfk4Uis-oCKCDpFpZrWJpbzAkbq7SqAqUoFm7wxgOS3BxrnSEERx2j7k9pNQglvTpuzX44sVA-roIt8ShRz5O0mDJM_5XzOJ6FmVleo_p_woCIoLK4sKpJ6rF9l_-5Rm5T-8A6_YcrCiW-hgIxoxUOnOXU2Cp80lh57rZdIk=&c=6DeHwgWLKXyyxXNvMUkbbOgyEBKdvTUcxPbzJeWriuAyB1vqNp5OgA==&ch=GP2eowkbwIFBRSBwWHxQtQZ81qguZkZUqet_g77_-th53qIqLrh0CA==)

# When they stalk our children,
# the government has gone too far.
---
| | | | |
---|---
### Candidates spend thousands (and even millions) of dollars on a marketing "Focus Group" to come up with campaign phrases that will catch the attention of voters. Instead of spending big bucks on a marketing consultant, I sat around the table with 15 members of my large Mexican family celebrating my brother's birthday.
My family is the perfect focus group. We are a mixture of Republicans and Democrats and enjoy many spirited discussions. When it came to talk about our children, both factions reached the non-partisan conclusion that "the government has gone too far" when they come for our kids.
The government now makes it official that they want a separation between parents and their children! The government thinks they can raise your children better than you can!
I believe that, "When they stalk our children, the government has gone too far." is a unifying message that will put common sense Democrats and Republicans on the same page. Please help me get this message out so that I can carry your voice to Congress and join with a new Republican Administration to clean up the mess LEFT by the LEFT.

Cuando acosan a nuestro hijos,
el gobierno ha ido demasiado lejos.

body:
| | | Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin here.
When Virginians elected me in 2021, it sent a shockwave across the country and proved that commonsense conservative leadership can win anywhere in America. Virginians hired an outsider and businessman as their Governor to help put Virginia back on the path to prosperity. We lowered taxes, created jobs, reclaimed the honor of America’s Top State for Business, put parents back at the head seat of the table in their children’s lives, and provided record funding for our students, teachers, and law enforcement heroes.
This positive change would not have been possible without committed, hardworking voters who devoted their time, energy, and resources to winning that historic election in 2021.
In 2024, we have another historic opportunity to make positive change for the entire country by electing Donald J. Trump as President and sending a Republican Majority to the United States Senate.
Even in Virginia, a state Joe Biden won by 10 points in 2020, we are seeing a competitive presidential race and an opportunity to flip a critical Senate seat too.
But we cannot do this without you.
We know Vice President Harris and Senate Democrats will raise hundreds of millions of dollars to win in November. If we let them outpace us in energy and resources, we will get the same failed policies of the last four years for the next four years. We won’t secure our southern border, we won’t bring down the cost of living, and we won’t restore peace through strength around the world.
**[That is why I am asking you to please make a contribution of any amount to help Republicans win in November with a strong Republican Senate Majority to support a President Trump agenda.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f2a57b94f332430c86c9c2238203f877&_e=z8geKt0WWEMVTMeSAj3p-FmSyMGY3kwsJAK3SjTtMcSmYSGjShebtAaTS6gMyqn5pyWRxbEa4A5gN_gbM--3xiPHIT99kEHsHvU7wbrKETtq-wmZ3oqXX0naWaP81GVNSCjrRxIM0iU1U9D4e4SFRfcTQKyVkGF5EcjLeN9VQR0vPDUcXudD9ppajhFc45qK4dzZuK8WFTtyqIFNen4ue9spM8m9n3ugRZO8cJP7kKusoB0rh1m1cX19O5cSMzXOMDvVV75T223fTJUQMjSVBbvH52y9ySqHAiVJkEJa5MIoM-5RE_3dbuaEUTHKpZbwADHeWqaPhhU2FYELvIgJmYlg4vMcM_IVRCDmi1AFE3XZYLAiaYfsjgb5p2NNg-vAAc-KMbU0-1Yp9ZDbNSj8-nNS6GzkOmR1o2fjqE34XFSMoNm2LOcMrDssepdGWesO0LA1a7fp-DaOtkdFFDXDCvMa2mPBOv8a9DpSeWD3oS6xXqqh0YaQx1Tk9a4e8gXIbqj7J9GlxIuLy7qYrm1lUw7-fXlZIeeBBGR9Xj7WV9wHkNPA2iDKEQPN8gxtyxqO)**

body:
I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” | [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=01ac0d8ef2f542b99aa3d44039aafb6c&_e=ya68HLKFniV5XG0mHbHdaoEuIQLQzMsiwsPp4IcgLtmxPVSLV5covSz-aDISr9g7n3ahAeoPIfJ8e7kZKOf_etmpLpv2E9ZFLVZ9dfFeu4gCVZmZcOPOvO4PgYu2pOLI3y4sAG6Ya8Geh-ZL-0DXYLZp3iQLGMYvIvjtG_w0E3zDpJzfqWm9H3Ui2XyXKxHuwCaXRlCNX91cjuTo_tNIHBogUXt4hYBQTmA7YFzkCQyhx06aLFq0d1iFhhMGuwbraWYUSG8XU8Bnp3vj3Kp8TRU31Ypwg624cJx4ApPtYBz6kuMOkex1p6HDmhIwq4UqW47BnxGvKPsFyuHlQHEpofw2AKsckKwg8VsJd1-sZ33rVh0tmN8hokHo3m0DkKHzB9X5UPDcq58JgEJYEYXGqR2js-6XKAoyJaiQCeujRjw%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=01ac0d8ef2f542b99aa3d44039aafb6c&_e=ya68HLKFniV5XG0mHbHdaoEuIQLQzMsiwsPp4IcgLtmxPVSLV5covSz-aDISr9g7n3ahAeoPIfJ8e7kZKOf_etmpLpv2E9ZFLVZ9dfFeu4gCVZmZcOPOvO4PgYu2pOLI3y4sAG6Ya8Geh-ZL-0DXYLZp3iQLGMYvIvjtG_w0E3zDpJzfqWm9H3Ui2XyXKxHuwCaXRlCNX91cjuTo_tNIHBogUXt4hYBQTmA7YFzkCQyhx06aLFq0d1iFhhMGuwbraWYUSG8XU8Bnp3vj3Kp8TXm5-0oPFlT_CDvYc7NJHiImNT9KYj47ECfqe6Kqv8FwW3AdyC9TrTOhuIQ9rP5V56k0tA3tTRNiRfM-NTFj6_vQg55t-mH8Pwas1j6kODFM85fDTOV9QM5FTChg_lpMiSdRIV3cUZPGeZe28CjjJrk%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=01ac0d8ef2f542b99aa3d44039aafb6c&_e=ya68HLKFniV5XG0mHbHdaoEuIQLQzMsiwsPp4IcgLtmxPVSLV5covSz-aDISr9g7n3ahAeoPIfJ8e7kZKOf_etmpLpv2E9ZFLVZ9dfFeu4gCVZmZcOPOvO4PgYu2pOLI3y4sAG6Ya8Geh-ZL-0DXYLZp3iQLGMYvIvjtG_w0E3zDpJzfqWm9H3Ui2XyXKxHuwCaXRlCNX91cjuTo_tNIHBogUXt4hYBQTmA7YFzkCQyhx06aLFq0d1iFhhMGuwbraWYUSG8XU8Bnp3vj3Kp8TfD2KKn3i-P25YrDR5NMaBvQbMhV6v-sjXF8VvSH_vOTMFA9WhYAgvZjdQJzz-wY0fm_dIgJk3ZPzhFpsZJ4KnjTu8yM2ZyChSMULk-z7rP1H6kjK5aYC0dYhCN0ylZEUPxRZDL7wFgARd6UBNMACiw%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

Louisiana's governor, Jeff Landry, has now signed eleven anti-voter bills into law so far this year. He started off with these seven new suppressive laws:
➜ House Bill 285 requires the state secretary of state’s office to create an election integrity division to perform many duties, including “ conducting independent investigations into allegations of election irregularities .”
➜ House Bill 476 restricts people from delivering more than one absentee ballot via mail unless they are sending ballots on behalf of immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 155 only allows individuals to assist with more than one absentee ballot if they are helping immediate family members.
➜ Senate Bill 218 requires someone assisting a voter to provide their address and relationship to the voter and reveal if they were paid to assist.
➜ Senate Bill 226 requires that an absentee ballot that is missing information and is not fixed by the voter is considered a challenged ballot that is only counted if the majority of the election board decides it should be.
➜ Senate Bill 449 defines a qualified voter or elector as “ a person who has the proper qualifications provided by law to be entitled to vote and who is lawfully registered to vote .”
➜ Senate Bill 101 bans ranked-choice voting in Louisiana elections.
Every single one of these bills was passed with an eye on adding barriers to voting, reducing ballot access, and suppressing participation in Louisiana's elections. Opponents of voting rights are trying to codify their pathway to power in state law instead of winning elections fair and square.

Because the U.S. continues to arm and fund Israel’s assault on Gaza, the Israeli military is now launching its biggest attack on the West Bank in 20 years. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWz7L52T-kvbUZG2XaYHUguQkR5k0waVT6iUVTMFpddGklWtLtjQ6H1qIPh1BmmBU-YTh74R5fXhSJWDJnPBiIM6Buwgq3JpB_JFJ35MG714QI4PWIdTNJT-V4Je9Evba40QfezzrhTR3qBI0dOlpIm67L6vpHznLiQb9qLdtcFhiUebaDj1elC8B2DzCW1DJhfCHjXGhuUf_oC7HRckDbYmcIOXA0AW50_n5cmzbyx1YAG_v3ilEz2yj1tpt_AD-4/49c/zBM7UmZ6QqWw0tu11nPUIg/h0/h001.9vOuts3xtADlNG7gTCbkTrJ8nrFSoetQtFyqB-TwolQ)

Friend, This week, University of Michigan students held a peaceful “die-in” protest while holding photographs of dead Palestinian children, chanting “Israel bombs, U of M pays, how many kids have you killed today?” The university sent in police to violently arrest protesters, in a shameful sign of the repressive tactics to come at schools across the country this semester. **Attacks on students’ First Amendment rights are clear attempts to silence dissent and stop people from speaking up against our country’s role in this genocide.** With 70% of the Israeli military’s weapons coming from the United States, our government has the power to end the flow of weapons and stop this genocide immediately. Because the U.S. continues to arm and fund Israel’s assault on Gaza, the Israeli military is now launching its biggest attack on the West Bank in 20 years. Our country must stop arming war crimes and violations of international law. We must act now to stop innocent children from being shot in the head by Israeli snipers, dismembered by U.S. bombs while sheltering in “safe zones” and UN schools, and deliberately starved to death. We must listen to—not silence or brutalize—the U.S. students and school employees who are demanding an end to this ethnic cleansing. [**Sign on now to tell U.S. college and university administrators, and the boards that oversee them: Listen to students and staff demanding divestment from genocide, rather than criminalizing them. Protect your students and their First Amendment rights.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbcudTzsjCJEadn461GaJZ-4WszxwX2xShkrxHO7jctc0T3vT5eShmvXZJR8E9_CLgxHtoF4FksuNjOSbHladUMzcTKALvVrEVVQUs4m4jrf87E9Omny5y0RSnP0S354IfxgEm6bhx2HepuThE_UCcWvIBGCJkLgyIm-unL0hFFWvcxKqWBafBrxajkVlIG0-xcd__3fnQ75BylIErEPcO7ZG214N60EnRp-zHJMCpmmF1DaRiD4ycSkV_-EkgSAYYgGp5xotQGJaKJ9eX7gGWam-YK5l-eVuc2-i0Yv8ISDX-HWJGfvk9VpAFNKySAoO0_S-krt7MWaGiOrcBNnDXf4uaFOjnPBiDZfOzsMel1iY1LYpM2w0qXutgEMyeXIbPw5NOeXdXJPIPRUvattVLfHJthmQ0XQoQ7RXJvvkotnfFTTfYB4DeATK5dRZs4z4V_7ThMW1-ziGPWG50BFSO0w/49c/zBM7UmZ6QqWw0tu11nPUIg/h1/h001.V8T11cfLx1jgO9IgiviBHDN83dlxp_4ktCx2-EFOjYM) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbcudTzsjCJEadn461GaJZ-4WszxwX2xShkrxHO7jctc0T3vT5eShmvXZJR8E9_CLgxHtoF4FksuNjOSbHladUMzcTKALvVrEVVQUs4m4jrf87E9Omny5y0RSnP0S354IfxgEm6bhx2HepuThE_UCcWu0UJsSpL93IIGxzxrtCd5hKusaU_U4mdrBzg8nqs5pURXG6Ze5mV6mBy5aiiMmckDqKjayMDV-h3xLsLz200MTNOmnYonIffWkMbgclRNNwb6VnzS-n0hbwWNxg2Z4AXlz1OQl5qSFHBMPFIhDrwtp1d70o5J9hR7ukekSivJVSajvKeWwVbeZ17wXueAb8ol15g_ntT14J8V0VjdThLFjp9FvjQ4zMT9f1wtkPxzv7b0Z2KOlOLOHPsVQBkOrN5mnshfvWL8_wuk7xWIXqMfZlKuAEJOgrz4VsOe2cg_kb4fn9bXuLBSOI18G5Ol7cQg/49c/zBM7UmZ6QqWw0tu11nPUIg/h2/h001.YRbmVqHFg3n3n9xPchzwHp3feTvR40ybFPp1P2dmyXo)

Earlier this year I had the opportunity to visit the University of Michigan’s Gaza solidarity encampment on the Diag, an area of campus historically used for student protests.
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbcudTzsjCJEadn461GaJZ-4WszxwX2xShkrxHO7jctc0T3vT5eShmvXZJR8E9_CLgxHtoF4FksuNjOSbHladUMzcTKALvVrEVVQUs4m4jrf87E9Omny5y0RSnP0S354IfxgEm6bhx2HepuThE_UCcWlWQCCdVKcE7HwETDO0YZ8TykwuYD-105tlGVbanmwVPKyFmoF6Lq-BknMdB3iflN9cQ_Yj1HYom-44i8SsfpRktZj2Gn7iVcmzE-0fO-DcG99wEgG6MIE9Wu-VRadwc2jHeDQXKbPwa9bQogDcN04xwgzwTehNkqvrHPdxFUY2hIoR5IZBA2G-fYTecOgR3ajIUPIKmULAXnWOg4yIDleYOM7hLxrNbzXf2MyTm08wbc4wV1Zi-nhrEYqglCR2D2yR-UxuL3G9SBh42pOSsH8K7L6rRjXpuKULCYWXkf0SYe8i9sYLYi7xwJx5FMUVSVw/49c/zBM7UmZ6QqWw0tu11nPUIg/h3/h001.8wnNGkD2lsB8I7Ki8tOIPb0u9ovqM_G-nSUo4SLu1h0)
_ Photo credit: Adam J. Dewey _
That’s where students held their protest at a back-to-campus event this week.
I also visited with students at their encampment at my alma mater, Wayne State University.**** While I was on Wayne State’s campus, officers in a police SUV tried to drive through a crowd of students.
**For calling to save lives, U.S. students and some staff have been brutally beaten, tased, and sprayed with toxic chemicals.** Across the country, universities are also firing pro-Palestine faculty and staff.
I stand with students and employees who are demanding that their universities divest from weapons manufacturers that are sending bombs to murder innocent Palestinian children. Many of these protests have already led to universities divesting.
The right to protest is essential to social change and to democracy. It’s also a fundamental constitutional right as part of our free speech protections in the First Amendment. In addition,**** schools have a responsibility to keep students protected from violence, including police violence.
**[Please add your name to join the call to U.S. colleges and universities: End the repressive tactics and violent crackdowns on pro-Palestine protests. Your students’ constitutional rights don’t end when they enter campus grounds, and you’re supposed to protect them—not endanger them with police brutality.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbcudTzsjCJEadn461GaJZ-4WszxwX2xShkrxHO7jctc0T3vT5eShmvXZJR8E9_CLgxHtoF4FksuNjOSbHladUMzcTKALvVrEVVQUs4m4jrf87E9Omny5y0RSnP0S354IfxgEm6bhx2HepuThE_UCcWoBk0PRfEroV2ee-mrCsfjO_399XxILLe5NVTtwHvR8Day0s5z72mr8q26uqxyBKh17vSEv6Lv4qEHnwN_Yi7RZNDCYg7HlErwyak99XKeDWYhG7Ef3YpcfHTLi0Eqkwgog3dmb7FcCURfw1YdGunzolof6lLvKM3JpnKTZ6ED01olQJu-NcWYQ3BnfrnynSiVMAej6p0zo5NpNQ-fSdBb52kjKxN6QwtTsqLAhM2yRCQ-GQMkjR4FmuyFh-t4zjNDOrCmVMzNd17UTlRua1_CvG04NSb-HLpXKa6ekorFeyYzCl-tMD_oAvH7aW2ghulQ/49c/zBM7UmZ6QqWw0tu11nPUIg/h4/h001.qBNXuWEJ9UKhPEGY4wET7KsE81-Ndh3Rfwqkul8vj08)**
Thank you for demanding a society that respects our shared humanity, upholds our human rights, and values all life.
In solidarity,
Rashida

subject: Shattering expectations

Peter: Gen Z will outlive the NRA. The Daily Beast recently analyzed the NRA’s tax returns. They aren’t pretty.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240830&t=1&akid=1126%2E587540%2Elzi2sx)
Mark my words, Peter: **Gen Z will outlive the NRA.**
_The Daily Beast_ analyzed the NRA’s tax returns a few months ago. They aren’t pretty.
In fact, the pro-gun group’s revenue has been on the decline for years now, especially since Parkland. _Last year, their fundraising was at its lowest point since 2008. And since 2018 they have lost over 1 million members._
I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—and as their power and influence fade into the dustbin of history, we will replace their corrupt, purchased politicians with a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action to stop the scourge of gun violence in America.
**I co-founded Leaders We Deserve because Gen Z’s answer to the NRA is electing more and more young people to public office to counter their agenda.**
**[With so much riding on the upcoming elections, we’re preparing now so we can elect all of our endorsed candidates on Election Day. Will you rush a $5 contribution now to help us meet our end-of-month fundraising goal and elect the leaders we deserve this November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240830?refcode=em20240830&amount=5&refcode2=1126_587540_lzi2sx&akid=1126%2E587540%2Elzi2sx)**

We founded Leaders We Deserve last year to elect the next generation of leadership—and folks across the country are already helping us shatter expectations.
Not only have tens of thousands of people just like you joined our movement and helped spread the word about our mission, we’ve already elected _multiple_ candidates since we started.
In the days leading up to last November’s election, we hit the streets in Virginia to knock on doors and get out the vote for **Nadarius Clark.** Thanks to our supporters’ donations, we were proud to invest more than $100,000 to support Nadarius’s campaign.
When all the ballots were counted, _Nadarius won by less than 2,000 votes._
And just a few months ago, we were proud to help **Molly Cook** win a special election to become the youngest and first-ever LGBTQ+ member of the Texas Senate. We’re going to make sure she wins a full term this November!
